taxonomy.label: 模型与任务
taxonomy.def: 按模态和任务组织的模型与算法及其开源实现：大语言与多模态模型、结构化决策模型、视觉、语音、图像与视频生成、经典 NLP、强化学习、推荐系统

subs.label: 大语言与多模态模型
subs.def: 开源权重的基座 / 推理 / 代码 / 多模态大语言模型，含 GPT-2、Llama 这类早期模型
subs.def_en: Open-weight base, reasoning, coding, and multimodal language models, including early ones such as GPT-2 and Llama

subs.label: 结构化决策模型
subs.def: 根据输入上下文，对调用方指定的选项、等级或是非问题直接输出类型化判断与概率的模型；不生成开放式文本
subs.def_en: Models that directly return typed choices, scores, or yes/no probabilities for caller-defined questions over input context, rather than generating open-ended text

subs.label: 预训练模型与经典 NLP
subs.def: 非通用聊天大模型的预训练基础模型（如 BERT、时序与金融模型），以及传统 NLP 库和序列建模工具；通用生成式语言模型归「大语言与多模态模型」
subs.def_en: Pretrained models other than general-purpose chat LLMs (such as BERT, time-series, and financial models), plus traditional NLP libraries and sequence-modeling tools; general generative language models belong in LLMs & Multimodal Models

subs.label: 计算机视觉
subs.def: 目标检测、分割、人脸与姿态、视觉基础模型与 3D 视觉；OCR 引擎归入「文档解析与 OCR」
subs.def_en: Object detection, segmentation, face and pose, vision foundation models, and 3D vision; OCR engines go under Document Parsing & OCR

subs.label: 语音识别
subs.def: 语音转文字模型、推理加速与听写工具（Whisper 系、DeepSpeech 一类）
subs.def_en: Speech-to-text models, inference accelerators, and dictation tools (Whisper family, DeepSpeech)

subs.label: 语音合成、声音转换与音频处理
subs.def: 文字转语音、声音克隆与变声、音频分离，以及音频 / 音乐生成
subs.def_en: Text-to-speech, voice cloning and conversion, audio source separation, and audio and music generation

subs.label: 图像与视频生成
subs.def: 从文本、噪声或工作流生成新图像 / 视频的模型与创作界面；以修改输入图像为主要任务的工具归「图像增强与换脸」
subs.def_en: Models and creative interfaces that generate new images or video from prompts, noise, or workflows; tools primarily transforming input images belong in Image Enhancement & Face Swapping

subs.label: 图像转换、增强与换脸
subs.def: 以已有图像 / 视频为输入进行图像转换、超分、修复、去背景、局部编辑、换脸或插帧；从零生成新作品的工具归「图像与视频生成」
subs.def_en: Transform existing images or video through image-to-image translation, upscaling, restoration, background removal, local edits, face swapping, or frame interpolation; generation from scratch belongs in Image & Video Generation

subs.label: 强化学习与具身智能
subs.def: 强化学习环境与算法，以及机器人定位、建图、路径规划、运动控制和具身智能仿真；通用算法教材归全栈「算法与数据结构」
subs.def_en: Reinforcement-learning environments and algorithms, plus robot localization, mapping, path planning, motion control, and embodied-AI simulation; general algorithm textbooks belong in Full-stack Algorithms & Data Structures

subs.label: 推荐系统
subs.def: 推荐与排序系统的模型和线上服务代码，包括社交平台开源的信息流推荐算法
subs.def_en: Models and serving code for recommendation and ranking systems, including feed-recommendation algorithms open-sourced by social platforms

taxonomy.def_en: Models and algorithms organized by modality and task, with their open-source implementations: language and multimodal models, structured decision models, vision, speech, image and video generation, classic NLP, reinforcement learning, and recommender systems

taxonomy.label: 训练、推理与工具链
taxonomy.def: 模型开发与运行所需的框架、训练、部署、接入、评测和配套工具；按仓库的核心交付物归类，不以是否支持本机运行或提供 API 为唯一依据

subs.label: 框架与数值基础库
subs.def: 通用的深度学习 / 机器学习与模型定义框架、自动微分、分布式计算及端侧推理框架，以及 NumPy、pandas 这类基础库（PyTorch、Transformers、TensorFlow、JAX、scikit-learn、XGBoost 一类）
subs.def_en: General deep learning, machine learning, and model-definition frameworks, autodiff, distributed computing, on-device inference frameworks, and base libraries such as NumPy and pandas (PyTorch, Transformers, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit-learn, XGBoost)

subs.label: 训练与微调
subs.def: 以训练、微调、强化学习后训练或修改模型权重为核心交付物的工具与流程；附带推理功能仍按模型改造归类
subs.def_en: Tools and workflows primarily for training, fine-tuning, RL post-training, or modifying model weights; incidental inference support does not change their primary category

subs.label: 推理服务与加速
subs.def: 以多请求 / 多用户推理 API、调度和吞吐优化为核心交付物的服务引擎，以及训练与推理共用的底层加速库；可部署在本机
subs.def_en: Engines centered on multi-request or multi-user inference APIs, scheduling, and throughput, plus low-level acceleration libraries shared by training and inference; they may also run locally

subs.label: 本地推理
subs.def: 以个人电脑、手机或端侧设备上直接运行模型、或挑选适配模型为主要体验的引擎与工具；带本机 API 不自动归入推理服务类
subs.def_en: Engines and tools centered on running or selecting suitable models on personal computers, phones, and edge devices; a local API alone does not make them serving platforms

subs.label: API 网关与中转
subs.def: 统一多家模型 API、路由转发、订阅中转
subs.def_en: Unify multiple model APIs, route requests, and relay subscriptions

subs.label: 观测、评测与 Prompt 管理
subs.def: LLM 应用的链路追踪、评测、红队与 Prompt 优化
subs.def_en: Tracing, evaluation, red-teaming, and prompt optimization for LLM apps

subs.label: 标注、可视化与 Demo 工具
subs.def: 数据标注、模型可视化与可解释性、机器学习 Demo 界面等围绕模型开发的工具
subs.def_en: Tools around model development: data labeling, model visualization and interpretability, and machine-learning demo UIs

taxonomy.def_en: Frameworks, training, deployment, access, evaluation, and related tooling for building and running models; classify each repository by its core deliverable, not solely by local support or an API

taxonomy.label: 数据与检索
taxonomy.def: 把外部数据变成 AI 可用的输入：抓取、解析、检索

subs.label: RAG 与知识库
subs.def: 把外部文档与知识库索引、检索并提供给问答 / 生成流程；持久保存 Agent 自身执行经验和跨会话记忆归「记忆与上下文」
subs.def_en: Index and retrieve external documents or knowledge for question answering and generation; persistent agent experience and cross-session memory belong in Memory & Context

subs.label: 向量数据库
subs.def: 向量存储与相似度检索
subs.def_en: Vector storage and similarity search

subs.label: 网页抓取
subs.def: 以 LLM / Agent 使用为目标抓取网页或社交内容，输出可供模型处理的 Markdown、结构化数据或工具接口；通用爬虫归全栈的「网页抓取与数据采集」
subs.def_en: Crawl web or social content for LLMs and agents, producing model-ready Markdown, structured data, or tool interfaces; general-purpose scrapers belong in Full-stack Web Scraping & Data Collection

subs.label: 文档解析与 OCR
subs.def: PDF / Office 等文件转 Markdown、结构化信息抽取；含 OCR 引擎
subs.def_en: PDF and Office files to Markdown, plus structured information extraction; includes OCR engines

subs.label: 数据分析 / Text-to-SQL
subs.def: 用自然语言查询数据库与表格
subs.def_en: Query databases and tables in natural language

taxonomy.def_en: Turning external data into model-ready input: crawling, parsing, retrieval

taxonomy.label: Agent 基础组件
taxonomy.def: 给 Agent 补上记忆、手脚和运行环境的组件

subs.label: 记忆与上下文
subs.def: 持久保存并检索 Agent 的对话、执行经验和长期上下文；面向外部资料问答的文档索引归「RAG 与知识库」
subs.def_en: Persist and retrieve agent conversations, execution experience, and long-term context; document indexes for external-knowledge Q&A belong in RAG & Knowledge Bases

subs.label: Token 压缩
subs.def: 在内容进入上下文前做压缩 / 过滤，降低 token 消耗
subs.def_en: Compress or filter content before it enters the context window to cut token cost

subs.label: 浏览器自动化
subs.def: 给 Agent 用的浏览器、无头浏览器与浏览器操控 SDK
subs.def_en: Browsers, headless browsers, and browser-control SDKs built for agents

subs.label: MCP 与工具接入
subs.def: 供 Agent 调用外部软件、网站与数据的 MCP 服务器、工具接入平台、Agent CLI 和 MCP 应用框架；协议规范及官方协议 SDK 归「协议与格式规范」
subs.def_en: MCP servers, tool integration platforms, agent-facing CLIs, and MCP application frameworks that connect agents to software, websites, and data; specifications and official protocol SDKs belong in Protocols & Formats

subs.label: 沙箱与运行时
subs.def: 隔离执行 AI 生成代码 / Agent 的安全环境
subs.def_en: Isolated environments for running AI-generated code and agents safely

taxonomy.def_en: Components that give agents memory, hands, and a runtime

taxonomy.label: Agent 开发框架与平台
taxonomy.def: 自己动手搭 Agent / LLM 应用用的框架、平台和协议

subs.label: 代码框架 / SDK
subs.def: 用代码构建 Agent / LLM 应用的框架、SDK 与模型 API 客户端；现成的终端编码 Agent、聊天产品和可视化编排平台分别归对应应用类
subs.def_en: Code frameworks, SDKs, and model API clients for building agents and LLM applications; ready-to-use coding agents, chat products, and visual workflow platforms belong in their respective application categories

subs.label: 低代码 / 工作流平台
subs.def: 可视化编排 Agent、RAG 与自动化流程的平台
subs.def_en: Visual platforms for orchestrating agents, RAG, and automation

subs.label: 协议与格式规范
subs.def: Agent 与工具互通的开放协议、指令文件格式及官方参考 SDK；第三方 MCP 服务器和应用框架归「MCP 与工具接入」
subs.def_en: Open interoperability protocols, instruction-file formats, and official reference SDKs for agents and tools; third-party MCP servers and application frameworks belong in MCP & Tool Integration

subs.label: 多智能体仿真
subs.def: 通过多个 Agent 互动来模拟社会、群体行为或趋势的研究与仿真环境；多个模型对同一问题投票的聊天工具不属于仿真
subs.def_en: Research and simulation environments where agents interact to model societies, collective behavior, or trends; chat tools that compare model answers are not simulations

taxonomy.def_en: Frameworks, platforms, and protocols for building agents and LLM apps yourself

taxonomy.label: Agent 应用
taxonomy.def: 开箱即用、直接拿来用的 Agent / 聊天产品

subs.label: 个人 AI 助理
subs.def: 常驻运行在自己机器上、通过 IM 等多渠道触达的个人 Agent
subs.def_en: Always-on personal agents running on your own machine, reachable through IM and other channels

subs.label: 通用 / 研究型 Agent
subs.def: 给一个目标即可自主规划执行的通用 Agent（Manus 类、深度研究类）
subs.def_en: Agents that plan and execute autonomously from a single goal (Manus-style, deep research)

subs.label: GUI 操控 Agent
subs.def: 看屏幕、点界面，操作电脑 / 手机 / 网页的 Agent
subs.def_en: Agents that see the screen and operate computers, phones, or web pages

subs.label: 聊天客户端
subs.def: 对接云端或本地模型的现成聊天界面、桌面客户端与多模型对照问答工具；以构建 Agent 为目的的 SDK 归「代码框架 / SDK」
subs.def_en: Ready-to-use chat interfaces, desktop clients, and multi-model answer-comparison tools for cloud or local models; SDKs for building agents belong in Code Frameworks & SDKs

taxonomy.def_en: Ready-to-use agent and chat products

taxonomy.label: 编码 Agent 生态
taxonomy.def: 编码 Agent 本体，以及围绕 Claude Code / Codex 等的周边工具

subs.label: 编码 Agent
subs.def: 终端 / IDE 里读代码、改代码、跑命令的 Agent 本体
subs.def_en: Agents in the terminal or IDE that read code, edit code, and run commands

subs.label: 多 Agent 工作台
subs.def: 同时调度多个编码 Agent，按任务 / 看板 / 工作流协作
subs.def_en: Orchestrate several coding agents by task, kanban, or workflow

subs.label: 客户端与配置增强
subs.def: 给现有编码 Agent 加 GUI、终端、HUD、移动端、配置模板、供应商切换
subs.def_en: GUIs, terminals, HUDs, mobile clients, config templates, and provider switching for existing coding agents

subs.label: 代码理解与评审
subs.def: 代码知识图谱、代码库打包、最新文档注入、自动代码评审
subs.def_en: Code knowledge graphs, repo packing, up-to-date docs injection, and automated code review

taxonomy.def_en: Coding agents themselves, plus tooling built around Claude Code, Codex, and similar

taxonomy.label: Agent 技能与方法论
taxonomy.def: 装进现有 Agent 的 Skills / 插件 / 工作流规范

subs.label: 开发方法论
subs.def: 覆盖需求、规划、实现和复核等多个阶段的成体系 Agent 开发方法；单一任务的可安装技能归对应技能类
subs.def_en: End-to-end agent development methods spanning requirements, planning, implementation, and review; installable skills for a single task belong in the relevant skill category

subs.label: 工程实践技能
subs.def: 可安装到 Agent 的工程实践技能，聚焦编码、规划、测试、安全审计等具体任务；完整开发流程方法论归「开发方法论」
subs.def_en: Installable engineering skills for specific coding, planning, testing, or security-audit tasks; complete development processes belong in Development Methodologies

subs.label: 设计与内容技能
subs.def: 可安装到 Agent 的 UI、图表、PPT、视频、配图与文案等设计和内容制作技能；独立运行的创作应用归「内容与设计创作」
subs.def_en: Installable agent skills for UI, diagrams, slides, video, images, and writing; standalone creative applications belong in Content & Design Creation

subs.label: 行业与知识工作技能
subs.def: 科研、营销、产品、安全、人物蒸馏等领域技能包
subs.def_en: Skill packs for research, marketing, product, security, persona distillation, and more

subs.label: 技能库、管理与审计
subs.def: 官方技能库、插件目录、技能合集清单，以及技能安装、管理与安全扫描工具
subs.def_en: Official skill libraries, plugin directories, skill collections, and tools for installing, managing, and scanning skills for security

taxonomy.def_en: Skills, plugins, and workflow conventions that plug into existing agents

taxonomy.label: AI 垂类应用
taxonomy.def: 面向具体行业 / 场景的 AI 应用

subs.label: 金融与交易
subs.def: 选股、投研、量化交易
subs.def_en: Stock picking, investment research, quantitative trading

subs.label: 内容与设计创作
subs.def: 以 AI 生成为核心的独立内容创作应用与平台，覆盖视频、演示文稿、设计稿和社媒内容；通用发布工具归全栈业务应用，Agent 技能归「设计与内容技能」
subs.def_en: Standalone applications and platforms centered on AI-generated video, slides, designs, or social content; general publishing tools belong in Full-stack Business Apps and agent skills in Design & Content Skills

subs.label: 安全与渗透测试
subs.def: 自主渗透测试与漏洞验证
subs.def_en: Autonomous penetration testing and vulnerability validation

subs.label: 搜索、情报与舆情
subs.def: AI 搜索引擎、新闻热点与舆情监控
subs.def_en: AI search engines, news trends, and public-opinion monitoring

subs.label: 知识管理与学习
subs.def: 笔记、NotebookLM 类工具、AI 辅导、论文翻译、会议纪要
subs.def_en: Notes, NotebookLM-style tools, AI tutoring, paper translation, meeting minutes

subs.label: 求职
subs.def: 职位筛选、简历优化、自动投递与投递追踪
subs.def_en: Job screening, resume optimization, automated applications, and application tracking

taxonomy.def_en: AI applications for specific industries and scenarios

taxonomy.label: 学习资源
taxonomy.def: LLM、Agent、机器学习与深度学习的教程、图书、Prompt 与 Awesome 合集

subs.label: LLM 原理与训练教程
subs.def: 从零实现 / 训练大模型的课程、图书与路线图
subs.def_en: Courses, books, and roadmaps for building and training LLMs from scratch

subs.label: Agent 与应用开发教程
subs.def: Agent、RAG、Prompt 工程、Claude Code 的教程与官方 Cookbook
subs.def_en: Tutorials and official cookbooks for agents, RAG, prompt engineering, and Claude Code

subs.label: 深度学习教程与论文精读
subs.def: 深度学习的课程、图书、代码教程、论文复现与精读
subs.def_en: Courses, books, code tutorials, paper reimplementations, and paper walkthroughs for deep learning

subs.label: 机器学习与数据科学教程
subs.def: 传统机器学习、数据科学与 AI 通识的课程、图书、笔记和学习路线
subs.def_en: Courses, books, notes, and learning roadmaps for classical machine learning, data science, and general AI

subs.label: Prompt 与系统提示词
subs.def: Prompt 库与各家 AI 产品的系统提示词合集
subs.def_en: Prompt libraries and collections of AI products' system prompts

subs.label: Awesome 合集
subs.def: LLM、Agent、ML / DL / CV / NLP 方向的项目与资源精选清单（技能类清单归入「技能库、管理与审计」）
subs.def_en: Curated lists of projects and resources on LLMs, agents, ML, DL, CV, and NLP (skill-related lists go under Skill Hubs, Management & Auditing)

taxonomy.def_en: Tutorials, books, prompts, and awesome lists for LLMs, agents, machine learning, and deep learning

projects.name: morluto/rea
projects.summary: 面向 Agent 的逆向工程 MCP 工具，把应用行为、运行时分析以及 Ghidra、Hopper 等二进制反编译能力统一到一个入口，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等客户端。
projects.summary_en: Reverse-engineering MCP tool for agents that unifies application behavior, runtime analysis, and binary decompilation through tools such as Ghidra and Hopper, with support for clients including Claude Code and Codex.

projects.name: openclaw/openclaw
projects.summary: 可自行部署的个人 AI 助理网关，通过多种聊天渠道接收请求，并将模型、工具和记忆接入本地运行环境。
projects.summary_en: A self-hostable personal AI assistant gateway that accepts requests from chat channels and connects models, tools, and memory in a local runtime.

review.reason: 缩短双语摘要并保留核心交付物；安全事件仅保留可核对的仓库公告。

projects.name: mattpocock/skills
projects.summary: 作者本人日常工程实践中实际使用的 Agent 技能合集，刻意做得小、易改、可组合、不绑定具体模型；可作为 Claude Code 插件整体订阅，也可以用 skills.sh 把可编辑的技能文件拷进项目自行魔改。
projects.summary_en: The author's own everyday agent skills, deliberately small, editable, composable, and model-agnostic. Subscribe to the whole set as a Claude Code plugin, or copy editable skill files into a project with skills.sh and hack on them.

projects.name: obra/superpowers
projects.summary: 面向编码 Agent 的完整软件开发方法论，由一组可组合的技能加初始指令构成，强制走“需求澄清→计划→TDD→子 Agent 驱动开发”的流程，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 等十几种工具。
projects.summary_en: Complete software-development methodology for coding agents, made of composable skills plus initial instructions that force a "clarify requirements, plan, TDD, sub-agent-driven development" flow. Supports a dozen-plus tools including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI.

projects.name: affaan-m/ECC
projects.summary: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor 等工具的 Agent Harness 性能优化系统，打包了技能、直觉记忆、安全防护和研究优先的开发流程；仓库本身 MIT 免费，同时有收费的 ECC Pro 托管版和 GitHub App。
projects.summary_en: Performance-optimization system for agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor, bundling skills, instinct memory, security guardrails, and a research-first development workflow. The repo itself is free under MIT; a paid hosted ECC Pro and a GitHub App also exist.

projects.name: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
projects.summary: DeepSeek 的开源 Agent 运行框架，以插件架构组织功能，提供本地 Web 界面与命令行入口。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek’s open-source agent harness organizes functionality through plugins and provides a local web UI and CLI.

review.reason: 核对仓库用途并改写双语摘要，去除易变数字、模糊宣传或非核心功能。

projects.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
projects.summary: Nous Research 出品的自我进化 Agent，可从使用经验中生成技能、沉淀知识并检索历史对话，支持多种部署方式、聊天入口和模型供应商。
projects.summary_en: A self-evolving agent from Nous Research that generates skills from experience, builds knowledge, and searches past conversations, with multiple deployment options, chat entry points, and model providers.

projects.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
projects.summary: 把 Andrej Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码毛病的一条推文（乱假设不澄清、过度设计、动不必要的代码/注释）提炼成四条原则，做成单个 CLAUDE.md 文件，直接合并进项目即可改善 Claude Code 的行为。
projects.summary_en: Distills a tweet by Andrej Karpathy about LLM coding faults (wrong assumptions without asking, over-engineering, touching unnecessary code and comments) into four principles in a single CLAUDE.md file that you merge into a project to improve Claude Code's behavior.

projects.name: anomalyco/opencode
projects.summary: 开源编码 Agent，提供跨平台命令行界面和桌面应用，支持 npm/brew/scoop/choco/pacman/nix 等多种方式安装，覆盖多种语言的本地化文档。
projects.summary_en: Open-source coding agent with a cross-platform CLI and a desktop app. Installable via npm, brew, scoop, choco, pacman, nix, and more, with localized docs in multiple languages.

projects.name: n8n-io/n8n
projects.summary: Fair-code 协议的工作流自动化平台，原本是通用集成工具，将 AI 能力融入核心：可视化画布加自定义代码搭建多步 Agent 工作流，接入 OpenAI/Anthropic/Google 等任意模型且不锁定供应商，自带集成与模板。
projects.summary_en: Fair-code workflow-automation platform that started as a general integration tool and integrates AI capabilities into its core: a visual canvas plus custom code for multi-step agent workflows, works with any model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more) without vendor lock-in, and ships with integrations and templates.

projects.name: tensorflow/tensorflow
projects.summary: Google 开源的端到端机器学习平台，提供 Python / C++ 的张量计算、自动微分、模型训练与部署工具链，覆盖服务器、移动端与浏览器。
projects.summary_en: Google's open-source end-to-end machine learning platform, with tensor computation, autodiff, and a training-to-deployment toolchain spanning servers, mobile, and the browser.

projects.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
projects.summary: 面向 Agent 的网页抓取 API，可搜索、抓取并与网页交互，将内容转成 Markdown 或结构化 JSON；支持 JavaScript 页面、代理轮换、自托管和托管服务。
projects.summary_en: A web-scraping API for agents that searches, scrapes, and interacts with pages, returning Markdown or structured JSON, with JavaScript-page support, proxy rotation, self-hosting, and a hosted service.

review.reason: 仓库由 Firecrawl 项目团队或组织直接维护，统一官方标记与仓库归属。

projects.name: ultraworkers/claw-code
projects.summary: claw 命令行 Agent 框架（harness）的公开 Rust 实现，仓库提供构建、认证、会话与奇偶校验等使用指南，支持接入本地 OpenAI 兼容模型与离线技能安装；项目自称是由 Agent 维护的「展品」，并建议实际工作使用 LazyCodex 或 Gajae-Code。
projects.summary_en: The public Rust implementation of the claw CLI agent harness, with guides for building, authentication, sessions, and parity checks, and support for local OpenAI-compatible models and offline skill installs; the project describes itself as an agent-managed exhibit and points to LazyCodex or Gajae-Code for real work.

projects.name: microsoft/markitdown
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的轻量 Python 工具，把 PDF、PPT、Word、Excel、图片（含 OCR）、音频等各类文件转换成 Markdown，专为 LLM 和文本分析流水线设计，优先保留标题、列表、表格、链接等文档结构而非追求给人看的高保真排版。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's lightweight Python tool that converts PDF, PPT, Word, Excel, images (with OCR), audio, and other files to Markdown, built for LLM and text-analysis pipelines. Prioritizes preserving structure such as headings, lists, tables, and links over human-facing high-fidelity layout.

projects.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
projects.summary: 开源 AI Agent 平台，用自然语言描述目标或在可视化编排器里逐步搭建，即可构建、部署、按需/定时/触发运行完整工作流；提供 AutoPilot、Agent 监控台、Marketplace 现成模板和可视化 Builder 四类入口。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI agent platform: describe a goal in natural language or build step by step in a visual orchestrator to create, deploy, and run complete workflows on demand, on a schedule, or by trigger. Four entry points: AutoPilot, an agent monitoring console, a Marketplace of ready-made templates, and a visual Builder.

projects.name: anthropics/skills
projects.summary: Anthropic 官方的 Agent Skills 参考实现仓库，Skills 是 Claude 动态加载的一组指令、脚本和资源文件夹，用于在特定任务上教会 Claude 可复用的做法，涵盖品牌文档生成、企业专属数据分析工作流、个人任务自动化等场景。
projects.summary_en: Anthropic's official reference implementation for Agent Skills. Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to learn repeatable ways of doing specific tasks, covering brand-compliant document generation, enterprise-specific data analysis workflows, personal task automation, and more.

projects.name: ollama/ollama
projects.summary: 在本地下载、运行和调用大语言模型的工具，提供命令行和 API 接口。
projects.summary_en: A tool for downloading, running, and calling language models locally through a CLI and API.

review.reason: 缩短双语摘要并保留核心交付物；安全事件仅保留可核对的仓库公告。

projects.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
projects.summary: 帮助编码 Agent 避免过度设计、以较少代码完成需求的技能，仓库提供基于 Claude Code 和 FastAPI/React 项目的对比案例。
projects.summary_en: A skill guiding coding agents to avoid overengineering and solve tasks with less code, with comparison cases using Claude Code on a FastAPI and React project.

projects.name: f/prompts.chat
projects.summary: 前身是 Awesome ChatGPT Prompts 的 AI Prompt 库网站，收录适配 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Llama、Mistral 等模型的提示词，可部署在公司内网。
projects.summary_en: Formerly Awesome ChatGPT Prompts, this AI prompt library site can be self-hosted. Prompts work across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and more.

projects.name: huggingface/transformers
projects.summary: Hugging Face 的模型定义框架，统一提供文本、视觉、音频和多模态模型实现，可供训练框架与推理引擎复用。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face model-definition framework for text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, with implementations reusable by training frameworks and inference engines.

projects.name: msitarzewski/agency-agents
projects.summary: 源自一个 Reddit 帖子、持续迭代打磨的“人格化”专家 Agent 角色合集，每个角色有独立性格、工作流程和交付标准，可安装进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini 等工具；也有配套的跨平台桌面 App 一键浏览安装。
projects.summary_en: Collection of "personified" specialist agent roles that grew out of a Reddit post and keeps being refined. Each role has its own personality, workflow, and deliverable standards, and can be installed into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, and more; a companion cross-platform desktop app offers one-click browsing and install.

projects.name: AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui
projects.summary: 基于 Gradio 的 Stable Diffusion 网页界面，提供文生图、图生图、局部重绘、放大、LoRA 与大量社区扩展，是本地跑扩散模型最常用的前端之一。
projects.summary_en: A Gradio-based web UI for Stable Diffusion with txt2img, img2img, inpainting, upscaling, LoRA support, and a large extension ecosystem; one of the most widely used front ends for running diffusion models locally.

projects.name: langgenius/dify
projects.summary: 开源 LLM 应用开发平台，把 Agentic 工作流、RAG 管道、模型管理和可观测性（集成 Opik/Langfuse/Arize）整合进一个协作工作区，支持云端、VPC、自托管三种部署方式，帮助团队从原型直接走到生产。
projects.summary_en: Open-source LLM app development platform that brings agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, model management, and observability (integrating Opik/Langfuse/Arize) into one collaborative workspace. Deploys in the cloud, in a VPC, or self-hosted, taking teams from prototype straight to production.

projects.name: open-webui/open-webui
projects.summary: 可自托管、可完全离线运行的 AI 交互界面，同时支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI 兼容 API，能接入 LMStudio、GroqCloud、Mistral、OpenRouter 等任意提供商，通过 pip/uv/Docker/Kubernetes 都能一键部署。
projects.summary_en: Self-hostable AI interface that can run fully offline. Supports Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs and works with any provider (LMStudio, GroqCloud, Mistral, OpenRouter, and more), deployable in one step via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes.

projects.name: langflow-ai/langflow
projects.summary: 可视化搭建和部署 AI Agent 工作流的平台，内置 API 和 MCP server，任何流程都能变成可被其他应用调用的工具；支持多 Agent 编排、LangSmith/LangFuse 可观测性，也提供开箱即用的 Langflow Desktop 桌面版。
projects.summary_en: Platform for visually building and deploying AI agent workflows, with a built-in API and MCP server so any flow can become a tool other apps call. Supports multi-agent orchestration and LangSmith/LangFuse observability, and offers a ready-to-use Langflow Desktop app.

projects.name: farion1231/cc-switch
projects.summary: 管理多个 AI 编码工具配置的跨平台桌面应用，用于切换模型服务、MCP、技能和提示词。
projects.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop app for managing AI coding-tool configurations, including model providers, MCP, skills, and prompts.

review.reason: 缩短双语摘要并保留核心交付物；安全事件仅保留可核对的仓库公告。

projects.name: langchain-ai/langchain
projects.summary: 定位为“Agent 工程平台”的框架，把可互操作的组件和第三方集成串联起来简化 LLM 应用开发；更高层的 Deep Agents 包提供规划、子 Agent、文件系统等内置能力，配套的 LangGraph 用于构建可控的 Agent 工作流编排。
projects.summary_en: Framework positioned as an "agent engineering platform" that chains interoperable components and third-party integrations to simplify LLM app development. The higher-level Deep Agents package adds planning, sub-agents, and a filesystem, and the companion LangGraph is used to build controllable agent workflows.

projects.name: github/spec-kit
projects.summary: GitHub 官方出品的规范驱动开发（SDD）工具包，给编码 Agent 提供结构化流程、可复用模板和留痕产出，覆盖建新功能、修 bug、评估想法三类独立场景，可自由组合或替换成自己的流程。
projects.summary_en: GitHub's spec-driven development (SDD) toolkit, giving coding agents a structured process, reusable templates, and traceable outputs. Covers three independent scenarios (new features, bug fixes, evaluating ideas) that can be combined or swapped for your own process.

projects.name: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill
projects.summary: 为编码 Agent 提供 UI/UX 设计智能的技能，v2.0 核心功能是“设计系统生成器”：输入项目需求，AI 推理引擎几秒内生成一套完整、定制化的设计系统，兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot 等多个平台。
projects.summary_en: Skill that brings UI/UX design intelligence to coding agents. The core of v2.0 is a "design-system generator": describe your project and an AI reasoning engine produces a complete, tailored design system in seconds. Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and more.

projects.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
projects.summary: 模块化的扩散模型图形界面与后端，用节点图串联采样、控制、放大等步骤，支持图像、视频和音频生成的可复用工作流。
projects.summary_en: A modular GUI and backend for diffusion models that chains sampling, control, and upscaling steps in a node graph, with reusable workflows for image, video, and audio generation.

projects.name: x1xhlol/system-prompts-and-models-of-ai-tools
projects.summary: 收集 Cursor、Claude Code、Devin、v0、Windsurf、Replit、Lovable、Perplexity 等几十款主流 AI 产品泄露/提取出的完整系统提示词和内部工具定义，用于研究这些产品的真实 Prompt 工程做法，也提醒创业公司注意系统提示词泄露风险。
projects.summary_en: Collects complete leaked or extracted system prompts and internal tool definitions from dozens of mainstream AI products (Cursor, Claude Code, Devin, v0, Windsurf, Replit, Lovable, Perplexity, and more) to study their real prompt-engineering practice, and to warn startups about system-prompt leakage risks.

projects.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
projects.summary: 100 多个开源 AI Agent、Agent 技能和 RAG 应用的合集，全部端到端跑通、Apache-2.0 协议，覆盖保险理赔、诈骗调查、旅行规划等具体场景，可以直接 clone 跑起来或当作 Claude Code 技能一键安装。
projects.summary_en: Collection of 100+ open-source AI agents, agent skills, and RAG apps, all run end to end and Apache-2.0 licensed, covering concrete scenarios such as insurance claims, fraud investigation, and trip planning. Clone and run them directly, or install them as Claude Code skills in one step.

projects.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
projects.summary: 给编码 Agent 用的 /graphify 技能，把整个代码库连同文档、SQL schema、配置、PDF 一起解析成可查询的知识图谱；代码部分用 tree-sitter 做纯本地确定性 AST 解析、不接 LLM 也不用向量库，每条边都标注是“直接抽取”还是“推断得出”。
projects.summary_en: A /graphify skill for coding agents that parses a whole codebase together with docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph. Code is parsed with purely local, deterministic tree-sitter ASTs, with no LLM and no vector store, and every edge is labeled as directly extracted or inferred.

projects.name: garrytan/gstack
projects.summary: Y Combinator 总裁 Garry Tan 公开的个人 Claude Code 配置，包含 分饰 CEO、设计师、工程经理、发布经理、文档工程师、QA 等角色的定制工具，用于说明一个人如何靠 AI Agent 做到团队级产出。
projects.summary_en: Y Combinator president Garry Tan's public personal Claude Code setup, with custom tools playing CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager, docs engineer, QA, and other roles, showing how one person can deliver team-level output with AI agents.

projects.name: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
projects.summary: 输入一个主题或关键词，自动生成视频脚本、匹配素材、生成字幕和背景音乐并合成高清短视频的一站式工具，支持接入 Kimi K3、DeepSeek 等大模型驱动文案与素材选择。
projects.summary_en: One-stop tool that turns a topic or keyword into a finished HD short video: it writes the script, matches footage, generates subtitles and background music, and composes the result. Can use LLMs such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek to drive copy and footage selection.

projects.name: ggml-org/llama.cpp
projects.summary: 以 C/C++ 实现的大语言模型推理引擎，支持量化模型在 CPU、GPU 和 Apple Silicon 等硬件上本地运行。
projects.summary_en: A C/C++ LLM inference engine for running quantized models locally on CPUs, GPUs, Apple Silicon, and other hardware.

review.reason: 核对仓库用途并改写双语摘要，去除易变数字、模糊宣传或非核心功能。

projects.name: openai/codex
projects.summary: OpenAI 官方出品的轻量终端编码 Agent，可作为 CLI、IDE 插件（VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf）或桌面 App 使用，也有对应的云端版本 Codex Web。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's lightweight terminal coding agent, usable as a CLI, IDE plugin (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf), or desktop app, with a cloud counterpart, Codex Web.

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md
projects.summary: 知名品牌与开发者网站设计系统的 DESIGN.md 合集，复制到项目里即可让 AI Agent 生成风格一致的页面。
projects.summary_en: A collection of DESIGN.md analyses of popular brand and developer-site design systems; drop one into a project so an AI agent can build pages in a matching style.

projects.name: microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的生成式 AI 入门课程，21 节课覆盖从基础概念到实际构建的完整路径，配套代码示例和多语言翻译（含简繁中文）。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's official generative-AI beginner course: 21 lessons covering the path from basic concepts to hands-on building, with code samples and multilingual translations (including Simplified and Traditional Chinese).

projects.name: TauricResearch/TradingAgents
projects.summary: 多智能体 LLM 金融交易框架，多个专业化 Agent 协作完成选股、回测和交易决策。
projects.summary_en: Multi-agent LLM financial-trading framework in which specialized agents collaborate on stock selection, backtesting, and trading decisions.

projects.name: earendil-works/pi
projects.summary: Pi Agent Harness 项目主页，包含自扩展的交互式编码 Agent CLI、带工具调用与状态管理的 Agent 运行时，以及统一多家模型（OpenAI/Anthropic/Google）的 LLM API 层。
projects.summary_en: Home of the Pi agent harness: a self-extending interactive coding-agent CLI, an agent runtime with tool calling and state management, and a unified LLM API layer across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

projects.name: browser-use/browser-use
projects.summary: 让 LLM Agent 操作浏览器完成网页任务，提供开源 Python/TypeScript 库、CLI、云端浏览器服务与托管 Agent API，并支持反爬和验证码处理。
projects.summary_en: Lets LLM agents operate a browser to complete web tasks, with open-source Python and TypeScript libraries, a CLI, a cloud browser service, and a hosted agent API with anti-bot and CAPTCHA handling.

review.reason: 仓库由 Browser Use 项目团队或组织直接维护，统一官方标记与仓库归属。

projects.name: JuliusBrussee/caveman
projects.summary: 让编码 Agent 用极简语言输出的技能与代理工具，通过压缩回复减少上下文和 token 消耗。
projects.summary_en: A skill and proxy tool that makes coding agents respond tersely, compressing their output to reduce context and token use.

projects.name: stablyai/orca
projects.summary: 面向“并行 Agent 舰队”的 ADE（Agent 开发环境），可同时运行 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 等多个编码 Agent，各自独立 worktree，桌面端和移动端均可监控与远程操作。
projects.summary_en: ADE (agent development environment) for "parallel agent fleets": runs Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and other coding agents at once, each in its own worktree, with monitoring and remote control from desktop and mobile.

projects.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
projects.summary: 为 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes 等各类 Agent 提供跨会话持久记忆的压缩系统，自动捕获会话内容、用 AI 压缩后在未来会话中注入相关上下文。
projects.summary_en: Compression-based persistent cross-session memory for agents such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, and Hermes: automatically captures session content, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context into future sessions.

projects.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
projects.summary: 面向 AI 编码 Agent 的生产级工程技能合集，把资深工程师在需求定义、方案设计、编码、测试、评审到上线全流程中的最佳实践打包成可复用技能。
projects.summary_en: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents, packaging senior-engineer best practices across requirements, design, coding, testing, review, and release into reusable skills.

projects.name: openai/whisper
projects.summary: OpenAI 基于大规模弱监督训练的通用语音识别模型，支持多语种转写、语音翻译和语种识别，提供多种尺寸的开源权重与 Python 推理代码。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's general-purpose speech recognition model trained with large-scale weak supervision, covering multilingual transcription, speech translation, and language identification, with open weights in several sizes.

projects.name: paperclipai/paperclip
projects.summary: 开源的 AI Agent 团队编排应用，Node.js 服务端 + React 界面，让你像管理公司一样给一群 AI Agent 分配目标、追踪工作和成本——“如果 OpenClaw 是员工，Paperclip 就是公司”。
projects.summary_en: Open-source app for orchestrating teams of AI agents (Node.js server plus React UI): assign goals, track work, and track cost across a group of agents the way you would manage a company. "If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company."

projects.name: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
projects.summary: 给 AI 编码 Agent“审美”的技能，防止生成千篇一律的模板化前端设计，定位为“反套路前端框架”。
projects.summary_en: A skill that gives AI coding agents "taste" and prevents generic, template-looking front-end designs; positioned as an "anti-cliché front-end framework".

projects.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
projects.summary: 给 AI Agent“装上互联网能力”的工具，一个 CLI 即可读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B 站、小红书等平台内容，具体 API 成本取决于所选平台。
projects.summary_en: Tool that "gives AI agents internet access": one CLI reads and searches content on Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and more, with API costs depending on the selected platform.

review.reason: README 的核心交付物是让 Agent 通过 CLI 搜索和读取多个网站的工具接入层，不是通用网页爬虫。

projects.name: google-gemini/gemini-cli
projects.summary: Google 出品的开源终端 AI Agent，把 Gemini 模型能力带进命令行，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令和 MCP 扩展。
projects.summary_en: An open-source terminal AI agent from Google that brings Gemini to the command line, with Google Search, file operations, shell commands, and MCP extensions.

projects.name: rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch
projects.summary: 配套图书《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》的官方代码仓库，手把手教你从零用 PyTorch 实现、预训练并微调一个类 GPT 的 LLM。
projects.summary_en: Official code repo for the book Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), walking you step by step through implementing, pre-training, and fine-tuning a GPT-like LLM in PyTorch.

projects.name: nexu-io/open-design
projects.summary: 开源的 Claude Design 替代品，本地优先桌面应用，把编码 Agent（Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/DeepSeek Harness 等 20+ CLI）变成设计引擎，可直接产出原型、着陆页、幻灯片等真实文件。
projects.summary_en: Open-source Claude Design alternative: a local-first desktop app that turns coding agents (20+ CLIs including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and DeepSeek Harness) into a design engine that directly produces real files such as prototypes, landing pages, and slides.

projects.name: pytorch/pytorch
projects.summary: 深度学习框架，提供张量计算、自动微分和 GPU 加速，用于构建及训练神经网络。
projects.summary_en: A deep learning framework with tensor operations, automatic differentiation, and GPU acceleration for building and training neural networks.

review.reason: 核对仓库用途并改写双语摘要，去除易变数字、模糊宣传或非核心功能。

projects.name: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3

projects.summary_en: Multi-agent framework that assigns GPT roles such as product manager, architect, and engineer to collaborate on software development. Its commercial spin-off MGX topped Product Hunt for a day and a week.

projects.name: code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent

projects.summary_en: Personal side-project agent enhancer: specific keywords trigger multi-model collaboration and graph-engineering capabilities, with a stronger memory system.

projects.name: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners

projects.summary_en: Microsoft's 12-week, 24-lesson introduction to artificial intelligence, covering symbolic AI, neural networks, computer vision, and NLP.

projects.name: docling-project/docling
projects.summary: 把 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、图片、音频等多种文档格式解析成统一表示，为生成式 AI 生态提供无缝对接的文档预处理能力，支持版面理解、表格结构识别等高级 PDF 解析。

projects.name: ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search
projects.summary: 基于 Claude Code 的求职自动化框架，用于评估职位、定制简历与求职信并准备面试。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code-based job-search automation framework for evaluating roles, tailoring resumes and cover letters, and preparing interviews.

projects.name: scikit-learn/scikit-learn

projects.name: Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm
projects.summary: 本地优先的一体化 AI 应用，可对接自己的文档聊天、用 AI Agent 自动化复杂工作流，多用户、高度可配置，桌面端（Mac/Windows/Linux）和移动端均已开源。
projects.summary_en: Local-first all-in-one AI app: chat with your own documents and automate complex workflows with AI agents. Multi-user and highly configurable; desktop (Mac/Windows/Linux) and mobile apps are open source.

projects.name: labmlai/annotated_deep_learning_paper_implementations
projects.summary: 深度学习论文的 PyTorch 简洁实现，附并排的逐行讲解，涵盖 Transformer、扩散模型、强化学习等。
projects.summary_en: Concise PyTorch implementations of deep learning papers with side-by-side line-by-line notes, covering transformers, diffusion models, reinforcement learning, and more.

projects.name: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
projects.summary: LLM 驱动的多市场（A股/港股/美股/日股/韩股/台股）股票智能分析系统，聚合行情与实时新闻生成决策看板，支持零成本定时运行并推送到企业微信/飞书/Telegram 等渠道。
projects.summary_en: LLM-driven multi-market stock analysis system (A-shares, Hong Kong, US, Japan, Korea, Taiwan) that aggregates quotes and real-time news into a decision dashboard. Runs on a schedule at zero cost and pushes to WeCom, Feishu, Telegram, and other channels.

projects.name: xtekky/gpt4free
projects.summary: 社区维护的多提供商 LLM 聚合项目，把各类可访问的免费模型和接口聚合成统一的 OpenAI 兼容 REST API，附带本地 GUI 和 Python/JS 客户端。
projects.summary_en: Community-maintained multi-provider LLM aggregator that combines accessible free models and endpoints into one OpenAI-compatible REST API, with a local GUI and Python/JS clients.

projects.name: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
projects.summary: 统一模型目录与多协议接入工具，连接免费、付费、订阅和本地模型供应商，供多种编码 Agent 切换模型。
projects.summary_en: A unified model catalog and multi-protocol integration tool connecting free, paid, subscription, and local model providers for use across coding agents.

projects.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
projects.summary: 跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、Hacker News、Polymarket 等平台调研任意话题并生成有依据摘要的 Agent 技能，按点赞数、真实资金等信号而非编辑好恶排序。
projects.summary_en: Agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and more, then writes a sourced summary ranked by signals such as upvotes and real money rather than editorial preference.

projects.name: blader/humanizer
projects.summary: 去除 AI 生成文本“机器味”的 Agent 技能，基于维基百科编辑用来识别 AI 生成内容的《Signs of AI writing》准则构建，适用于 Claude Code、Codex 等支持技能的 Agent。
projects.summary_en: Agent skill that removes the "machine feel" from AI-generated text, built on Wikipedia editors' "Signs of AI writing" guidelines. Works with skill-capable agents such as Claude Code and Codex.

projects.name: cathrynlavery/diagram-design

projects.summary_en: Editorial-grade diagram-design skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained pure HTML+SVG output that avoids Mermaid's default styling, supports a dozen-plus layouts (architecture, flowchart, sequence, and more), and can redraw existing draw.io/Mermaid diagrams.

projects.name: RVC-Boss/GPT-SoVITS

projects.summary_en: A few-shot voice cloning and text-to-speech WebUI that produces a target voice from seconds to a minute of reference audio, with zero-shot and fine-tuning modes plus dataset splitting and labeling tools.

projects.name: jingyaogong/minimind

projects.name: virattt/ai-hedge-fund
projects.summary: 用多个 AI 角色协作做交易决策的对冲基金概念验证项目，仅用于教育与研究，不执行真实交易。
projects.summary_en: A proof-of-concept AI hedge fund in which several AI personas collaborate on trading decisions, intended for education and research and not for real trading.

projects.name: karpathy/nanoGPT

projects.summary_en: Karpathy's minimal repository for training and fine-tuning GPTs, reproducing GPT-2-scale training in a few hundred lines of PyTorch. The author now marks it as outdated and points to nanochat.

projects.name: PlexPt/awesome-chatgpt-prompts-zh

projects.name: keras-team/keras

projects.summary_en: A deep learning framework designed for humans; Keras 3 is multi-backend, running the same model code on JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

projects.summary_en: Platform that gives LLMs and AI code editors up-to-date, version-specific code documentation, injecting current docs and examples straight into the prompt so models stop hallucinating APIs from stale training data.

projects.name: gsd-build/get-shit-done

projects.name: sansan0/TrendRadar

projects.summary_en: AI-driven public-opinion and trending-topic monitor: aggregates multi-platform trending lists and RSS feeds, supports precise keyword filtering, and uses AI to screen and translate news and push digests to your phone. Connects to MCP for natural-language analysis.

projects.name: Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model

projects.name: router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI

projects.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills

projects.summary_en: Skill library that turns any AI agent into an "AI scientist": validated research skills and scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and the open Agent Skills standard.

projects.name: HKUDS/DeepTutor

projects.summary_en: Lifelong personalized tutoring agent with a multilingual interface, workspace knowledge bases, image-and-text material upload, a task board, and conversation recovery, built on LightRAG for deep retrieval in education.

projects.name: Imbad0202/academic-research-skills

Stresses that humans keep the key decisions while AI handles legwork like finding literature and checking formatting; built-in multi-stage integrity checks guard against fabricated citations and methodology fraud.

projects.name: FlowiseAI/Flowise

projects.summary_en: Low-code platform for visually building AI agents. Archived (development has stopped); previously offered drag-and-drop agent, RAG, and chatbot building on the LangChain ecosystem.

projects.name: multica-ai/multica

projects.name: bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD

projects.summary_en: Agile AI-Driven Development methodology covering decisions, context handoff, and architecture from idea to working software. Use it end to end, or plug briefs, specs, and architecture into an existing delivery process.

projects.name: AntonOsika/gpt-engineer

projects.summary_en: A dependency-free C/C++ port of the Whisper speech recognition model, quantized and optimized for Apple Silicon and CPUs, suited to offline on-device transcription.

projects.summary_en: Motion and interaction-design skill pack for designers and engineers, distilled from years of taste by an author with Vercel/Linear background, helping agents avoid common "tasteless" motion mistakes.

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-openclaw-skills

Combines a deterministic rule engine with an LLM agent that reads whole files and searches the codebase for context, producing line-level deep review comments, with built-in multi-language rule sets for NPEs, thread safety, XSS, SQL injection, and more.

projects.name: ifixai-ai/iFixAi

projects.name: THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC
projects.summary: 清华大学出品的开放多智能体互动课堂，一键生成沉浸式多智能体学习体验，v1.0 新增 Agent Workbench，可从上传的资料自主规划课程、逐页构建并持续修订。
projects.summary_en: Tsinghua University's open multi-agent interactive classroom: generate an immersive multi-agent learning experience in one click. v1.0 adds an Agent Workbench that plans a course from uploaded material, builds it page by page, and keeps revising it.

projects.summary_en: Extreme memory-optimized LLM inference library: layer-by-layer streaming lets a 70B model run on a 4GB GPU. Supports single-GPU inference and training of very large models such as Kimi K3 (2.8T parameters) and DeepSeek-V3.

projects.name: volcengine/OpenViking

projects.summary_en: Anthropic's official set of reference agents, skills, and data connectors for investment banking, equity research, private equity, wealth management, and other financial scenarios. projects.name: RVC-Project/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI
projects.summary: 基于检索的语音音色转换框架，用不到十分钟的语音数据即可训练变声模型，带完整的 WebUI 训练与推理流程。
projects.summary_en: A retrieval-based voice conversion framework that trains a voice-changing model from under ten minutes of audio, with a full WebUI for training and inference.

projects.name: storytold/artcraft
projects.summary: 面向艺术家与影视创作者的交互式 AI 图像和视频创作环境，在 2D 画布与 3D 场景中组合构图、角色和镜头，再接不同生成模型产出可重复的结果。
projects.summary_en: Interactive AI image and video creation environment for artists and filmmakers. Compose scenes in 2D and 3D, control characters and cameras, and use different generation models for repeatable results.

projects.name: stanfordnlp/dspy
projects.summary: 斯坦福 NLP 实验室出品的框架，主张“编程而非提示”语言模型——用可组合的模块和优化器代替手写 prompt 字符串来构建和调优 LLM 应用。
projects.summary_en: Framework from the Stanford NLP Lab that argues for "programming, not prompting" language models: composable modules and optimizers replace hand-written prompt strings for building and tuning LLM apps.

projects.name: naptha/tesseract.js
projects.summary: Tesseract OCR 的纯 JavaScript / WebAssembly 版本，可在浏览器和 Node.js 中识别 多种语言。
projects.summary_en: A pure JavaScript and WebAssembly build of Tesseract OCR that recognizes many languages in the browser and in Node.js.

projects.name: chatchat-space/Langchain-Chatchat
projects.summary: 基于 LangChain 与 ChatGLM/Qwen/Llama 等模型实现的本地知识库 RAG 与 Agent 应用，支持离线私有部署，可用 Xinference/Ollama 等框架接入开源模型。
projects.summary_en: Local knowledge-base RAG and agent application built on LangChain and models such as ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. Supports offline private deployment and connects open-source models through frameworks like Xinference and Ollama.

projects.name: JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template
projects.summary: 网站克隆模板：给 AI 编码 Agent 一个网址，让它一键重建成 Next.js 应用，配合 Claude Code 等使用。
projects.summary_en: A website-cloning template: give an AI coding agent a URL and it recreates the site as a Next.js app, designed to work with agents such as Claude Code.

projects.name: AlexsJones/llmfit
projects.summary: 命令行硬件适配工具，检测你的 CPU/内存/GPU/显存配置，推荐能在本机流畅跑的开源 LLM 及量化方案，并可把实测 token/s 提交回项目共享给其他人参考。
projects.summary_en: Command-line hardware-fit tool that detects your CPU, RAM, GPU, and VRAM, recommends open-source LLMs and quantizations that run smoothly on your machine, and lets you submit measured tokens/s back to share with others.

projects.name: CopilotKit/CopilotKit
projects.summary: Agent 原生应用的前端技术栈，为 React/Angular/Vue/React Native 及 Slack/Teams 提供生成式 UI、共享状态和人机协同工作流，AG-UI 协议的提出方。
projects.summary_en: Frontend stack for agent-native apps: generative UI, shared state, and human-in-the-loop workflows for React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack, and Teams. Originator of the AG-UI protocol.

projects.name: sgl-project/sglang
projects.summary: 高性能 LLM/多模态模型推理服务框架，在 NVIDIA GB300 等新硬件上做推理性能优化。
projects.summary_en: High-performance serving framework for LLMs and multimodal models, with inference optimization on new hardware such as NVIDIA GB300.

projects.name: vercel-labs/skills
projects.summary: Vercel 官方出品的开放 Agent Skills 生态 CLI（npx skills），支持从 GitHub/GitLab/Azure Repos 等来源安装技能，兼容多种 Agent。
projects.summary_en: Vercel's CLI for the open Agent Skills ecosystem (npx skills): installs skills from GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, and other sources, and works with multiple agents.

projects.name: PDFMathTranslate/PDFMathTranslate
projects.summary: 保留排版的科学 PDF 双语翻译工具（EMNLP 2025 Demo），支持公式、图表、目录、批注完整保留，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero 多种接入方式，对接 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等翻译服务。
projects.summary_en: Layout-preserving bilingual translation for scientific PDFs (EMNLP 2025 demo), keeping formulas, figures, tables of contents, and annotations intact. Offers CLI, GUI, MCP, Docker, and Zotero access, and connects to translation services such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI.

projects.name: myshell-ai/OpenVoice
projects.summary: MIT 与 MyShell 发布的即时声音克隆模型，可精确复制参考音色并控制情感、口音与节奏，支持跨语种合成。
projects.summary_en: An instant voice cloning model from MIT and MyShell that reproduces a reference tone color with control over emotion, accent, and rhythm, including cross-lingual synthesis.

projects.name: fengdu78/Coursera-ML-AndrewNg-Notes
projects.summary: 斯坦福（吴恩达）机器学习课程的中文个人笔记，可在线阅读。
projects.summary_en: Personal Chinese notes on Andrew Ng's Stanford machine learning course, available to read online.

projects.name: ItzCrazyKns/Vane
projects.summary: 隐私优先、完全自托管的 AI 问答搜索引擎（原 Perplexica），支持本地 Ollama 与 OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/Groq 等云端模型，基于 SearxNG 聚合多搜索引擎并标注信息来源。
projects.summary_en: Privacy-first, fully self-hosted AI answer engine (formerly Perplexica). Supports local Ollama and cloud models such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Groq, and aggregates multiple search engines through SearxNG with cited sources.

projects.name: khoj-ai/khoj
projects.summary: 自托管的个人 AI 第二大脑，可对接任意本地或在线 LLM，从网络和本地文档中检索答案、创建自定义知识 Agent、定时自动化深度研究，支持浏览器/Obsidian/Emacs/手机/WhatsApp 多入口。
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted personal AI "second brain" that works with any local or online LLM, answers from the web and your documents, builds custom knowledge agents, and schedules automated deep research. Reachable from browser, Obsidian, Emacs, phone, and WhatsApp.

projects.name: musistudio/claude-code-router
projects.summary: 本地控制面板，把 Claude Code、Codex、Grok CLI、Kimi CLI 等编码 Agent 与任意模型供应商连接起来，统一路由、故障转移、扩展能力并观测每一次请求。
projects.summary_en: Local control panel that connects coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Grok CLI, and Kimi CLI to any model provider, with unified routing, failover, extensibility, and observability of every request.

projects.name: can1357/oh-my-pi
projects.summary: Stencil Labs 出品、fork 自 Pi 的编码 Agent，深度集成 IDE 能力，支持多家模型供应商、内置工具和 LSP 操作，核心用 Rust 实现。
projects.summary_en: Coding agent from Stencil Labs, forked from Pi, with deep IDE integration, multiple model providers, built-in tools, and LSP operations. Core implemented in Rust.

projects.name: exacity/deeplearningbook-chinese
projects.summary: 《Deep Learning》（花书）的中文翻译，由社区协作翻译与校对，以 LaTeX 维护。
projects.summary_en: A community-made Chinese translation of the Deep Learning textbook by Goodfellow, Bengio, and Courville, maintained in LaTeX.

projects.name: microsoft/Data-Science-For-Beginners
projects.summary: 微软的 10 周、20 课时数据科学入门课程，每课含课前课后测验。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's 10-week, 20-lesson introduction to data science, with pre- and post-lesson quizzes in every lesson.

projects.name: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
projects.summary: 个人交易 Agent，一条命令即可为 Agent 装备完整的量化交易能力，支持回测、多 Agent 协作和 MCP 接入。
projects.summary_en: Personal trading agent: one command equips an agent with full quantitative-trading capabilities, including backtesting, multi-agent collaboration, and MCP access.

projects.name: cjpais/Handy
projects.summary: 完全离线运行的开源跨平台语音转文字桌面应用，按下快捷键说话即可把文字输入到任意应用，基于 Tauri 构建。
projects.summary_en: A fully offline open-source cross-platform speech-to-text desktop app: press a shortcut, speak, and the text is typed into any application. Built with Tauri.

projects.name: TencentARC/GFPGAN
projects.summary: 腾讯 ARC 实验室的真实场景人脸修复算法，利用预训练人脸生成先验恢复老照片和低质量人像。
projects.summary_en: Tencent ARC Lab's blind face restoration algorithm that uses a pretrained face generative prior to restore old photos and low-quality portraits.

projects.name: alchaincyf/nuwa-skill
projects.summary: 把任意人物的思维方式（心智模型、决策启发式、表达风格）蒸馏成可复用 Agent 技能，输入一个名字自动完成调研、提炼、验证全流程，兼容多种 Agent 运行时。
projects.summary_en: Distills anyone's way of thinking (mental models, decision heuristics, expression style) into a reusable agent skill. Give it a name and it runs research, distillation, and validation automatically; compatible with multiple agent runtimes.

projects.name: ashishpatel26/500-AI-Machine-learning-Deep-learning-Computer-vision-NLP-Projects-with-code
projects.summary: 带代码的 AI、机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉与 NLP 项目清单。
projects.summary_en: A list of AI, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and NLP projects with code.

projects.name: google-ai-edge/mediapipe
projects.summary: Google 的跨平台端侧机器学习方案，提供手部、人脸、姿态等实时感知的现成管线，也支持自定义模型与端侧生成式 AI。
projects.summary_en: Google's cross-platform on-device ML solutions, offering ready-made real-time pipelines for hands, faces, and pose, with support for custom models and on-device generative AI.

projects.name: karpathy/LLM101n
projects.summary: Andrej Karpathy 发起的教学项目，计划从零手把手（Python/C/CUDA）教你搭建一个类 ChatGPT 的故事生成 LLM，目前该课程仍在由 Eureka Labs 开发中，仓库处于归档状态。
projects.summary_en: Andrej Karpathy's teaching project that plans to walk you through building a ChatGPT-like story-generating LLM from scratch (Python/C/CUDA). The course is still in development at Eureka Labs and the repo is archived.

projects.name: agentscope-ai/QwenPaw
projects.summary: 个人 AI 助理，易于本地或云端部署，三层记忆架构（工作上下文/完整历史/自进化知识库）、内置沙箱与工具/文件安全防护，支持多 Agent 并行与跨系统通信协议 ACP。
projects.summary_en: Personal AI assistant that is easy to deploy locally or in the cloud. Three-tier memory (working context, full history, self-evolving knowledge base), built-in sandbox and tool/file safeguards, parallel multi-agent execution, and the ACP cross-system communication protocol.

projects.name: xinntao/Real-ESRGAN
projects.summary: 面向真实场景的通用图像与视频超分修复算法，提供针对动漫图像和动漫视频的专用小模型。
projects.summary_en: A practical algorithm for general image and video super-resolution and restoration, with dedicated smaller models for anime images and anime video.

projects.name: LAION-AI/Open-Assistant
projects.summary: LAION 发起的开源聊天助手项目，目标是让所有人都能用上高质量对话式大模型，项目已于 2023 年完结，产出的 oasst2 数据集仍在 HuggingFace 开放。
projects.summary_en: LAION's open-source chat-assistant project, aiming to give everyone access to a high-quality conversational LLM. Concluded in 2023; its oasst2 dataset remains open on HuggingFace.

projects.name: songquanpeng/one-api
projects.summary: LLM API 统一管理与分发系统，支持 OpenAI/Azure/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/文心一言/通义千问等主流模型，单可执行文件、Docker 一键部署，用于 key 管理和二次分发。
projects.summary_en: Unified LLM API management and distribution system supporting OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, ERNIE Bot, Tongyi Qianwen, and other mainstream models. A single executable with one-step Docker deployment, used for key management and secondary distribution.

projects.name: huggingface/pytorch-image-models
projects.summary: timm 是 PyTorch 图像模型与预训练权重库，提供模型创建接口和训练、验证、推理脚本。
projects.summary_en: timm is a PyTorch image-model and pretrained-weight library with model creation APIs and training, validation, and inference scripts.

review.reason: 核对仓库用途并改写双语摘要，去除易变数字、模糊宣传或非核心功能。

projects.name: openai/gym
projects.summary: 经典的强化学习环境接口与基准集合。维护团队已将后续开发转到 Gymnasium，Gym 不再更新，仓库已归档。
projects.summary_en: The classic interface and benchmark suite for reinforcement learning environments. Development has moved to Gymnasium and this repository is archived.

projects.name: virgiliojr94/book-to-skill
projects.summary: 把技术书籍 PDF 或文档合集转换成 Claude Code 技能，供 Agent 按需检索和查阅，避免将整本书放入上下文。
projects.summary_en: Converts technical-book PDFs or document sets into Claude Code skills for on-demand retrieval instead of placing the entire book in context.

projects.name: langfuse/langfuse
projects.summary: 开源 LLM 应用可观测性与评测平台，追踪、评估、改进 AI 应用的一站式工具，可分钟级自托管，被 ClickHouse 收购后持续商业化运营。
projects.summary_en: Open-source LLM application observability and evaluation platform: one place to trace, evaluate, and improve AI apps, self-hostable in minutes. Continues to operate commercially after being acquired by ClickHouse.

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
projects.summary: 精选（非 AI 批量生成）的官方团队 Agent Skills 合集，收录 Claude、VoltAgent、Supabase、Stripe、Google Gemini 等团队发布的真实技能，兼容 Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Gemini CLI 等。
projects.summary_en: Curated (not AI-bulk-generated) collection of Agent Skills from official teams, including real skills published by Claude, VoltAgent, Supabase, Stripe, Google Gemini, and others. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more.

projects.name: babysor/MockingBird
projects.summary: 以中文为主的实时声音克隆项目，几秒参考音频即可合成任意文本。作者已表示不再积极更新。
projects.summary_en: A Chinese-focused real-time voice cloning project that synthesizes arbitrary text from a few seconds of reference audio. The author says it is no longer actively updated.

projects.name: DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io
projects.summary: 把 AI 与 draw.io 结合的 Next.js 网页应用，通过对话创建、修改和优化图表。
projects.summary_en: A Next.js web application that integrates AI with draw.io, creating, modifying, and improving diagrams through chat.

projects.name: Tencent/WeKnora
projects.summary: 腾讯官方出品的开源 LLM 知识平台，把原始文档变成可查询的 RAG、自主推理 Agent 和自维护 Wiki 三合一系统，支持从 ClawHub/SkillHub 安装技能扩展 Agent 工具箱。
projects.summary_en: Tencent's open-source LLM knowledge platform that turns raw documents into a three-in-one system of queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining wiki. Supports installing skills from ClawHub/SkillHub to extend the agent's toolbox.

projects.name: jax-ml/jax
projects.summary: 可组合的 Python + NumPy 程序变换库，提供自动微分、向量化和即时编译，可在 GPU / TPU 上高性能运行，是许多大模型训练栈的基础。
projects.summary_en: A library of composable transformations for Python and NumPy programs: autodiff, vectorization, and JIT compilation for GPUs and TPUs, and a foundation of many large-model training stacks.

projects.name: microsoft/graphrag
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的模块化图谱式检索增强生成系统，通过构建知识图谱提升复杂问答场景下的检索质量。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's modular graph-based retrieval-augmented generation system, building a knowledge graph to improve retrieval quality for complex question answering.

projects.name: hankcs/HanLP
projects.summary: 多语种自然语言处理工具包，基于 PyTorch 与 TensorFlow 2，提供分词、词性标注、依存句法、命名实体识别等十余种联合任务。
projects.summary_en: A multilingual NLP toolkit on PyTorch and TensorFlow 2 that supports joint tasks including tokenization, part-of-speech tagging, dependency parsing, and named entity recognition across many languages.

projects.name: continuedev/continue
projects.summary: 开源编码 Agent，可接入 IDE 或终端，支持自定义模型和规则，帮助开发者在保留控制权的前提下把 AI 编码能力集成进现有工作流。
projects.summary_en: Open-source coding agent for IDEs and the terminal, with custom models and rules, helping developers bring AI coding into existing workflows while keeping control.

projects.name: reworkd/AgentGPT
projects.summary: 早期知名的浏览器端自主 Agent 项目，输入一个目标即可配置、部署自主 AI Agent，自动拆解任务、执行并从结果中学习。
projects.summary_en: Early well-known in-browser autonomous agent: enter a goal to configure and deploy an autonomous AI agent that breaks down tasks, executes them, and learns from the results.

projects.name: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
projects.summary: 面向终端的 DeepSeek 原生编码 Agent，围绕 prefix-cache 稳定性设计、可长时间挂机运行，单一 Go 二进制，支持终端/桌面/浏览器/编辑器（ACP）四种接入方式。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek-native coding agent for the terminal, designed around prefix-cache stability and long unattended runs. A single Go binary with four access modes: terminal, desktop, browser, and editor (ACP).

projects.name: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
projects.summary: 把单个 Claude Code 会话变成完整游戏开发工作室的技能包，分角色 Agent 和工作流技能，模拟真实工作室的导演/部门负责人/专家层级结构。
projects.summary_en: Skill pack that turns a single Claude Code session into a full game-development studio: role-specific agents and workflow skills, mirroring a real studio's director, department-lead, and specialist hierarchy.

projects.name: XingangPan/DragGAN
projects.summary: SIGGRAPH 2023 论文 DragGAN 的官方代码，允许在生成图像上拖动控制点来交互式编辑物体姿态和形状。
projects.summary_en: The official code for the SIGGRAPH 2023 paper DragGAN, which lets users drag control points on a generated image to interactively edit object pose and shape.

review.reason: 论文与 README 均以对已有生成图像拖动控制点进行编辑为核心。

projects.name: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
projects.summary: 面向 AI Agent 的网络安全技能库，技能覆盖多个安全领域，映射 MITRE ATT&CK/NIST CSF 等框架，社区项目，与 Anthropic 官方无关联，仅限授权测试使用。
projects.summary_en: Cybersecurity skill library for AI agents: skills across cybersecurity domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF. A community project unaffiliated with Anthropic, for authorized testing only.

projects.name: Leey21/awesome-ai-research-writing
projects.summary: 面向学术论文写作的提示词与 Agent 技能模板库，用于润色、改写等环节。
projects.summary_en: A library of prompts and agent-skill templates for academic paper writing, covering polishing, rewriting, and related steps.

projects.name: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
projects.summary: GPT Image 2 / 2.5 的提示词与案例库，含 案例、可复用模板与技能。
projects.summary_en: A prompt and case library for GPT Image 2 and 2.5, with cases, reusable templates, and skills.

projects.name: agentscope-ai/agentscope
projects.summary: 生产级易用的 Agent 框架 2.0，强调发挥模型自身推理和工具使用能力而非用死板提示词强行编排，支持团队流水线、模型路由等能力。
projects.summary_en: Production-ready, easy-to-use agent framework (v2.0) that emphasizes leveraging the model's own reasoning and tool use instead of forcing rigid prompt orchestration. Supports team pipelines, model routing, and more.

projects.name: qdrant/qdrant
projects.summary: Rust 编写的高性能向量数据库与搜索引擎，支持混合检索、多租户过滤，并提供官方 Agent Skills 让编码 Agent 直接做量化/分片等向量检索工程决策。
projects.summary_en: High-performance vector database and search engine written in Rust, with hybrid search and multi-tenant filtering, and official Agent Skills that let coding agents make vector-search engineering decisions such as quantization and sharding.

review.reason: 仓库由 Qdrant 项目团队或组织直接维护，统一官方标记与仓库归属。

projects.name: SillyTavern/SillyTavern
projects.summary: 面向重度玩家的本地 LLM 前端，统一对接 KoboldAI/NovelAI/OpenAI/Claude 等几乎所有文本生成后端，支持视觉小说模式、图像生成、TTS、World Info 角色设定和海量第三方扩展。
projects.summary_en: Local LLM front end for power users, connecting to nearly every text-generation backend (KoboldAI, NovelAI, OpenAI, Claude, and more), with visual-novel mode, image generation, TTS, World Info character setups, and a huge library of third-party extensions.

projects.name: google-research/timesfm
projects.summary: Google Research 的时间序列基础模型，采用纯解码器结构预训练，用于零样本时序预测。
projects.summary_en: Google Research's time-series foundation model, a decoder-only architecture pretrained for zero-shot forecasting.

projects.name: ocrmypdf/OCRmyPDF
projects.summary: 为扫描版 PDF 添加 OCR 文字层的命令行程序，使文档可搜索、可复制文字，基于 Tesseract，支持多语言、页面旋转与纠偏，默认输出 PDF/A，并默认使用多核并行处理。
projects.summary_en: A command-line program that adds an OCR text layer to scanned PDF files so they can be searched and copied from, built on Tesseract, with support for multiple languages, page rotation and deskewing, PDF/A output by default, and multi-core processing.

projects.name: fxsjy/jieba
projects.summary: 广泛使用的中文分词 Python 组件，提供精确、全、搜索引擎和 paddle 四种分词模式，并支持自定义词典与关键词提取。
projects.summary_en: A widely used Python component for Chinese word segmentation, with precise, full, search-engine, and paddle modes, custom dictionaries, and keyword extraction.

projects.name: anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop
projects.summary: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件生态打造的桌面客户端，把本地 Web UI、Host 服务和插件系统集成进原生应用，独立社区项目，与深度求索官方无隶属关系。
projects.summary_en: Desktop client for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin ecosystem, wrapping a local web UI, host service, and plugin system in a native app. An independent community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.

projects.name: NandhaKishorM/laya
projects.summary: 对输入文本直接输出选项、分数或是非判断的多语言决策模型，提供 Python 接口和 Agent 框架集成。
projects.summary_en: A multilingual decision model that directly returns choices, scores, or yes/no judgments for input text, with a Python API and agent-framework integrations.

review.reason: 核对仓库用途并改写双语摘要，去除易变数字、模糊宣传或非核心功能。

projects.name: facebookresearch/detectron2
projects.summary: Meta AI 基于 PyTorch 的目标检测与分割平台，是 Detectron 的重写版，提供 Mask R-CNN 等大量算法和模型库。

projects.summary_en: Open-source infrastructure for giving AI agents computers to use, with desktop automation drivers, isolated cloud desktops, local macOS VMs, and computer-use benchmarks.

projects.name: stanford-oval/storm
projects.summary: 斯坦福出品的 LLM 知识策展系统，输入一个主题即可自动研究并生成带引用的完整报告，EMNLP/NAACL 论文成果，已集成 litellm 支持多模型。
projects.summary_en: Stanford's LLM knowledge-curation system: give it a topic and it researches and writes a full cited report. An EMNLP/NAACL paper result, now integrated with litellm for multi-model support.

projects.name: hesamsheikh/awesome-openclaw-usecases
projects.summary: 社区收集的 OpenClaw 真实使用案例合集，覆盖社媒摘要、账号分析、自动化发帖等场景，提醒引用的第三方技能/插件未经审计需自行评估安全性。
projects.summary_en: Community-collected real-world OpenClaw use cases, covering social-media digests, account analytics, automated posting, and more. Warns that the third-party skills and plugins referenced are unaudited, so assess their safety yourself.

projects.name: garrytan/gbrain
projects.summary: 给已在使用的 Agent 一份自己可控的记忆：保存带来源的明确事实，支持更正与撤回，并在多个 Agent 间共享。
projects.summary_en: Gives the agent you already use a memory you control: it stores explicit facts with their sources, supports corrections and withdrawal, and shares the same memory across agents.

projects.name: supermemoryai/supermemory
projects.summary: AI 记忆与上下文引擎，提供长期记忆检索和上下文压缩，可在本地运行。
projects.summary_en: An AI memory and context engine with long-term memory retrieval and context compression that can run locally.

projects.name: Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning
projects.summary: 在 PyTorch 之上的训练框架，把研究代码与工程样板分离，支持多 GPU / 多节点扩展而几乎不改代码。
projects.summary_en: A training framework on top of PyTorch that separates research code from engineering boilerplate, scaling to multi-GPU and multi-node runs with almost no code changes.

projects.name: karpathy/llm.c
projects.summary: Karpathy 用纯 C / CUDA 实现的 LLM 训练代码，不依赖 PyTorch 和 Python，重点是复现 GPT-2 与 GPT-3 系列的预训练，并附有对应的 PyTorch 参考实现。
projects.summary_en: Karpathy's LLM training code in plain C and CUDA with no PyTorch or Python dependency, focused on reproducing GPT-2 and GPT-3 series pretraining, with a parallel PyTorch reference implementation.

projects.name: AMAI-GmbH/AI-Expert-Roadmap
projects.summary: 成为 AI 专家的路线图，用一组图表展示各方向应学的技术与工具。
projects.summary_en: A roadmap to becoming an AI expert, presented as charts of the technologies and tools to learn in each path.

projects.name: Chanzhaoyu/chatgpt-web
projects.summary: 用 Express 与 Vue 3 搭建的 ChatGPT 演示网页，可接入 OpenAI API。仓库已归档。
projects.summary_en: A ChatGPT demo web app built with Express and Vue 3 that connects to the OpenAI API. The repository is archived.

projects.name: oraios/serena
projects.summary: 强大的编码 MCP 工具箱，提供符号级语义代码检索、编辑和重构能力（近似 IDE），通过 MCP 接入任意客户端/LLM，让 Agent 在大型代码库里更快更可靠。
projects.summary_en: Powerful coding MCP toolkit offering symbol-level semantic code retrieval, editing, and refactoring (close to an IDE), plugged into any client or LLM through MCP so agents work faster and more reliably in large codebases.

projects.name: nanocoai/nanoclaw
projects.summary: 轻量级 OpenClaw 替代品，让每个 Agent 在独立容器中运行，采用精简的进程与文件结构，并提供 Slack 场景配置。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw that runs each agent in its own container, uses a compact process and file structure, and provides a Slack setup.

projects.name: langchain-ai/deepagents
projects.summary: LangChain 官方出品的“开箱即用” Agent Harness，基于 LangGraph 构建，内置子 Agent、可插拔文件系统、上下文管理、人类介入和技能加载，模型无关。
projects.summary_en: LangChain's "batteries-included" agent harness built on LangGraph, with sub-agents, a pluggable filesystem, context management, human-in-the-loop, and skill loading. Model-agnostic.

review.reason: 仓库由 LangChain 项目团队或组织直接维护，统一官方标记与仓库归属。

projects.name: iperov/DeepFaceLive
projects.summary: 面向直播和视频通话的实时换脸软件，用预训练的 DFM 人脸模型替换摄像头或视频里的人脸。仓库已归档。
projects.summary_en: Real-time face swap software for streaming and video calls that replaces a face in a webcam feed or video using pretrained DFM face models. The repository is archived.

projects.name: ComposioHQ/composio
projects.summary: 给 AI Agent 提供 预授权工具箱的平台，含按用户会话管理、鉴权、触发器和沙箱，支持 OpenAI Agents、Claude Agent SDK、LangChain 等主流框架的适配器。
projects.summary_en: Platform that gives AI agents pre-authorized toolkits, with per-user session management, auth, triggers, and sandboxes. Ships adapters for OpenAI Agents, Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, and other major frameworks.

projects.name: jackwener/OpenCLI
projects.summary: 把任意网站变成命令行接口，并借助已登录的 Chrome 会话让 AI Agent 以确定性的方式操作网站。
projects.summary_en: Turns any website into a command-line interface and lets AI agents operate sites deterministically through a logged-in Chrome session.

projects.name: tobi/qmd
projects.summary: 面向个人文档、知识库和会议记录的本地搜索引擎，结合 BM25、向量检索与 LLM 重排序，全部经 node-llama-cpp 在本机运行。
projects.summary_en: A local search engine for personal documents, knowledge bases, and meeting notes that combines BM25, vector search, and LLM re-ranking, all running on-device through node-llama-cpp.

projects.name: yetone/magpie
projects.summary: macOS 菜单栏中的本地模型网关，统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等编码 Agent 的模型与账号，支持模型切换和额度用尽后的自动故障转移。
projects.summary_en: A local model gateway in the macOS menu bar that manages models and accounts for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and other coding agents, with model switching and quota-aware failover.

review.reason: 核心是为多种编码 Agent 统一接入和切换模型，符合 AI 网关范围。

projects.name: AtsushiSakai/PythonRobotics
projects.summary: 用 Python 实现并讲解机器人定位、建图、路径规划和运动控制算法的代码与教材。
projects.summary_en: A Python code collection and textbook covering robot localization, mapping, path planning, and motion control algorithms.

review.reason: README 核对仓库交付物和当前开发状态后归入对应小类；未把路线图能力写成已实现。

projects.name: e2b-dev/awesome-ai-agents
projects.summary: AI 自主 Agent 项目合集，区分开源项目与闭源产品/公司两部分，由 E2B（Code Interpreter 服务商）维护。
projects.summary_en: Collection of autonomous AI agent projects, split into open-source projects and closed-source products/companies, maintained by E2B (a code-interpreter provider).

projects.name: eugeneyan/applied-ml
projects.summary: 收集各公司分享的数据科学与机器学习生产实践的论文、文章与博客。
projects.summary_en: Curated papers, articles, and blogs from companies on data science and machine learning in production.

projects.name: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
projects.summary: 百度的文档解析模型，主打一次性完成长文档的整体解析，并支持基于 ms-swift 的训练。
projects.summary_en: Baidu's document parsing model that aims to parse long documents in a single pass, with training support through ms-swift.

projects.name: browser-use/video-use
projects.summary: browser-use 团队出品的视频剪辑 Agent 技能，用 Claude Code 处理原始素材：去除口癖卡顿、自动调色、加字幕、生成动效转场并自我评估渲染效果。
projects.summary_en: Video-editing agent skill from the browser-use team. Uses Claude Code on raw footage to cut filler words and stumbles, color-grade, add subtitles, generate motion transitions, and self-evaluate the render.

review_history.reason: 仓库由 Browser Use 项目团队或组织直接维护，统一官方标记与仓库归属。

review.reason: README 的安装与日常使用围绕 Agent 视频剪辑技能及辅助脚本，而非独立创作平台。

projects.name: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
projects.summary: 腾讯云官方出品的团队级 Agent 记忆中枢，把对话、文档、代码沉淀成四类可复用记忆资产（对话记忆/技能/LLM-Wiki/代码图谱），跨 Agent 和框架共享治理。
projects.summary_en: Tencent Cloud's team-level agent memory hub that distills conversations, documents, and code into four kinds of reusable memory assets (conversation memory, skills, LLM-Wiki, code graph), shared and governed across agents and frameworks.

projects.name: facefusion/facefusion
projects.summary: 开源的人脸处理平台，提供图片和视频的换脸、口型同步、人脸增强等功能，可通过界面或命令行使用。
projects.summary_en: An open-source face manipulation platform offering face swapping, lip sync, and face enhancement for images and video, usable from a UI or the command line.

projects.name: openai/openai-agents-python
projects.summary: OpenAI 官方出品的轻量级多智能体工作流框架，供应商无关，支持 OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions 及 100+ 其他 LLM，内置 Agent、沙箱 Agent 和实时 Agent 三类核心概念。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's lightweight multi-agent workflow framework. Provider-agnostic, supporting OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions and 100+ other LLMs, with three core concepts built in: agents, sandbox agents, and realtime agents.

projects.name: assafelovic/gpt-researcher
projects.summary: 自主深度研究 Agent，支持任意 LLM 供应商，对任意主题做规划、检索、自我校验后生成带引用的详细研究报告，受 Plan-and-Solve 和 RAG 论文启发。
projects.summary_en: Autonomous deep-research agent that works with any LLM provider. Plans, retrieves, and self-verifies on any topic, then writes a detailed, cited research report. Inspired by the Plan-and-Solve and RAG papers.

projects.name: h4ckf0r0day/obscura
projects.summary: 用 Rust 从零实现的无头浏览器，专为 AI Agent 自动化和网页抓取设计，不依赖 Chromium，内存和启动速度大幅优于 headless Chrome 且内置反检测。
projects.summary_en: Headless browser written from scratch in Rust for AI-agent automation and web scraping. Independent of Chromium, with far lower memory use and faster startup than headless Chrome, plus built-in anti-detection.

projects.name: google-research/tuning_playbook
projects.summary: Google Research 的深度学习调参手册，系统讲解如何选择模型结构、批大小、学习率等以最大化模型性能。
projects.summary_en: A deep learning tuning playbook from Google Research that systematically covers choosing architectures, batch sizes, learning rates, and more to maximize model performance.

projects.name: academic/awesome-datascience
projects.summary: 数据科学学习与实践资源清单，含学习路线、工具、数据集与课程。
projects.summary_en: A curated data science resource list to learn and apply concepts to real-world problems, with study paths, tools, datasets, and courses.

projects.name: NirDiamant/RAG_Techniques
projects.summary: 可运行的 Notebook 教程，系统讲解从基础到前沿的 RAG 技术实现原理和代码，社区驱动的教学项目。
projects.summary_en: Runnable notebook tutorials that systematically explain RAG techniques from basics to the frontier, with principles and code. A community-driven teaching project.

projects.name: huggingface/smolagents
projects.summary: Hugging Face 官方出品的极简 Agent 库，核心逻辑约 1000 行代码，主打“用代码而非 JSON 写行动”的 CodeAgent，支持沙箱执行和 Hub 分享。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's minimalist agent library: the core logic is about 1,000 lines, centered on a CodeAgent that writes actions as code rather than JSON, with sandboxed execution and Hub sharing.

projects.name: tatsu-lab/stanford_alpaca

projects.summary_en: The Stanford Alpaca project: 52K instruction-following examples, the method used to generate them, and training code for fine-tuning an instruction-following model from LLaMA.

projects.name: Genesis-Embodied-AI/genesis-world
projects.summary: 面向通用机器人与具身智能学习的仿真平台，集成统一的多物理引擎、照片级渲染器和跨平台编译器。
projects.summary_en: A simulation platform for general-purpose robotics and embodied AI learning, combining a unified multi-physics engine, a photo-realistic renderer, and a cross-platform compiler.

projects.name: opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf
projects.summary: 面向 AI 数据提取的 PDF 解析器，输出带边界框的 Markdown、JSON 与 HTML，并支持 PDF 无障碍自动化处理。
projects.summary_en: A PDF parser for AI data extraction that outputs Markdown, JSON with bounding boxes, and HTML, and also automates PDF accessibility tagging.

projects.name: rohitg00/agentmemory
projects.summary: 面向编码 Agent 的持久化记忆工具，基于置信度评分、生命周期管理和知识图谱混合检索，支持 Claude Code、Copilot、Cursor 等主流工具。
projects.summary_en: Persistent memory tool for coding agents, using confidence scoring, lifecycle management, and hybrid knowledge-graph retrieval. Supports Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and other mainstream tools.

projects.name: aishwaryanr/awesome-generative-ai-guide
projects.summary: 生成式 AI 一站式资源仓库，按“使用 AI / 构建 AI / 理解研究 / 面试准备”四条路径组织课程、论文、面试题和笔记本。
projects.summary_en: One-stop generative-AI resource repo organized along four paths: use AI, build AI, understand the research, and prepare for interviews. Includes courses, papers, interview questions, and notebooks.

projects.name: deepinsight/insightface
projects.summary: 2D 与 3D 人脸分析项目，提供人脸检测、识别、对齐和属性分析的算法、模型与 Python 库。
projects.summary_en: A 2D and 3D face analysis project with algorithms, models, and a Python library for face detection, recognition, alignment, and attribute analysis.

projects.name: JaidedAI/EasyOCR
projects.summary: 开箱即用的 Python OCR 库，支持多种语言和多种文字，基于深度学习的检测与识别模型。
projects.summary_en: A ready-to-use Python OCR library supporting many languages and many writing scripts, built on deep-learning detection and recognition models.

projects.name: modular/modular
projects.summary: Modular 平台的开源部分，包含 MAX 推理与服务框架和 Mojo 语言，目标是统一 AI 开发与部署。
projects.summary_en: The open-source components of the Modular Platform, including the MAX inference and serving framework and the Mojo language, aimed at unifying AI development and deployment.

projects.name: sipeed/picoclaw
projects.summary: 硬件厂商 Sipeed 用 Go 从零开发的轻量个人 AI 助理，面向低内存设备运行，采用独立实现而非现有项目的 fork。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight personal AI assistant built from scratch in Go by hardware maker Sipeed for low-memory devices, implemented independently rather than forked.

projects.name: HandsOnLLM/Hands-On-Large-Language-Models
projects.summary: O'Reilly 书籍《Hands-On Large Language Models》官方配套代码仓库，近 300 张自制配图讲解 LLM 实用工具和概念。
projects.summary_en: Official code repo for the O'Reilly book Hands-On Large Language Models, with nearly 300 custom illustrations explaining practical LLM tools and concepts.

projects.name: simstudioai/sim
projects.summary: 可自托管的 AI Agent 工作空间，可视化或用代码构建工作流，连接外部服务，并管理知识、执行记录和部署。
projects.summary_en: A self-hostable AI agent workspace for building workflows visually or in code, connecting external services, and managing knowledge, runs, and deployments.

review.reason: 核对仓库用途并改写双语摘要，去除易变数字、模糊宣传或非核心功能。

projects.summary_en: The English edition of Dive into Deep Learning: an interactive book with multi-framework code, math, and discussion forums, used by hundreds of universities.

projects.name: labring/FastGPT

projects.summary_en: LLM-based knowledge-base agent-building platform with out-of-the-box data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual workflow orchestration. Supports cloud and self-hosted deployment; from the Chinese team labring.

projects.name: harvard-edge/cs249r_book

projects.summary_en: Textbook for Harvard's CS249r course, Machine Learning Systems, covering fundamentals through agentic AI and physical AI. Free to read, with multilingual translations.

projects.name: ageron/handson-ml2
projects.summary: 《Hands-On Machine Learning》第二版的配套 Notebook。第三版已发布，本仓库已过时。
projects.summary_en: Notebooks for the second edition of Hands-On Machine Learning. The third edition is out and this repository is outdated.

projects.name: hpcaitech/Open-Sora
projects.summary: 开源视频生成项目，目标是以较低成本高效生成高质量视频，开放模型、工具和训练细节。
projects.summary_en: An open-source video generation project that aims to produce high-quality video efficiently, releasing models, tools, and training details.

projects.name: ATH-MaaS/Pixelle-Video
projects.summary: AI 全自动短视频引擎：输入主题即可自动撰写文案、生成配图或视频、合成配音并加背景音乐。
projects.summary_en: A fully automated AI short-video engine: enter a topic and it writes the script, generates images or video, synthesizes narration, and adds background music.

projects.name: chroma-core/chroma
projects.summary: 开源 AI 数据基础设施，专注检索/向量数据库，核心 API 仅 4 个函数即可上手，也提供托管的 Chroma Cloud 服务。

projects.name: alibaba/page-agent

projects.summary_en: A collection of data science Python notebooks covering TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn, pandas, Matplotlib, Spark, and more.

projects.summary_en: Collection of Claude Code skills and plugins spanning engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, academic research, and more. Compatible with multiple coding tools.

projects.name: mastra-ai/mastra

projects.summary_en: Modern full-stack TypeScript framework for AI apps and agents, with model routing (multiple providers), agents, a graph-based workflow engine, and human-in-the-loop. From a YC-backed team.

projects.summary_en: Web-slide generation skill for Claude Code and Codex, with two built-in visual systems ("e-magazine" and "Swiss International Style"). Produces single-file HTML horizontal-scroll decks with images and a presenter mode.

projects.name: yamadashy/repomix

projects.summary_en: Packs an entire code repository into a single AI-friendly file, making it easy to feed a codebase to any LLM for analysis, such as Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, or Gemini.
