projects.summary_en: AI resume-optimization tool supporting 100+ local and cloud LLMs: upload a resume and a job description to get targeted improvement suggestions, a cover letter, and interview prep.

projects.name: meta-llama/llama3

projects.summary_en: Meta's official Llama 3 open models. The README marks the repo deprecated; later functionality moved to the Llama Stack, made up of new repos such as llama-models and llama-toolchain.

projects.name: ChristosChristofidis/awesome-deep-learning
projects.summary: 深度学习教程、项目与社区的精选清单，含图书、课程、论文、框架与数据集。
projects.summary_en: A curated list of deep learning tutorials, projects, and communities, including books, courses, papers, frameworks, and datasets.

projects.name: jarrodwatts/claude-hud
projects.summary: Claude Code 插件，在状态栏实时显示上下文占用、活跃工具、运行中的子 Agent 和待办进度。
projects.summary_en: Claude Code plugin that shows context usage, active tools, running sub-agents, and todo progress live in the status line.

projects.name: ml-explore/mlx
projects.summary: Apple 机器学习研究团队的数组框架，面向 Apple Silicon，采用统一内存和惰性计算，提供类 NumPy 与 PyTorch 的 API。
projects.summary_en: An array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon from Apple machine learning research, with unified memory, lazy computation, and NumPy- and PyTorch-like APIs.

projects.name: QwenLM/qwen-code
projects.summary: 阿里云 Qwen 团队官方出品的开源终端编码 Agent，内置 Auto-Memory、Auto-Skills、子 Agent 团队，支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Qwen 多协议和本地模型。
projects.summary_en: Open-source terminal coding agent from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team, with Auto-Memory, Auto-Skills, and sub-agent teams. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Qwen protocols as well as local models.

projects.name: invoke-ai/InvokeAI
projects.summary: 面向创作者的 Stable Diffusion 系创作引擎，提供带画布的 Web 界面、节点工作流和多种模型支持。
projects.summary_en: A creative engine for Stable Diffusion-family models aimed at creators, with a web UI including a canvas, node-based workflows, and support for many models.

projects.name: charmbracelet/crush
projects.summary: Charm 团队出品的终端编码 Agent，支持任意 LLM（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API）、多会话上下文保留、LSP 增强和 MCP 扩展，覆盖几乎所有终端平台。
projects.summary_en: Terminal coding agent from the Charm team. Works with any LLM (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs), keeps multi-session context, adds LSP enhancement and MCP extensions, and runs on nearly every terminal platform.

projects.name: dmlc/xgboost
projects.summary: 高效、灵活、可移植的分布式梯度提升库（GBDT），提供 Python、R、JVM 等接口，是表格数据建模的常用工具。
projects.summary_en: An efficient, flexible, and portable distributed gradient boosting library (GBDT) with Python, R, and JVM interfaces, a standard tool for tabular data modeling.

projects.name: ZuzooVn/machine-learning-for-software-engineers
projects.summary: 给软件工程师的机器学习自学计划，按每日任务自上而下安排学习内容，参照 Coding Interview University。
projects.summary_en: A daily study plan for software engineers to become machine learning engineers, arranged top-down and inspired by Coding Interview University.

projects.name: firecrawl/open-lovable
projects.summary: Firecrawl 团队出品的示例应用，几秒内把任意网站克隆重建成现代 React 应用，演示 Firecrawl 抓取能力与 LLM 结合的效果。
projects.summary_en: Demo app from the Firecrawl team that clones and rebuilds any website as a modern React app in seconds, showing what Firecrawl scraping plus an LLM can do.

projects.name: alchaincyf/huashu-design
projects.summary: HTML 原生设计技能，一句话在 Claude Code 等 Agent 里产出高保真原型、动画、可编辑 PPT 和信息图，内置设计哲学和风格预设防止千篇一律。
projects.summary_en: HTML-native design skill that produces high-fidelity prototypes, animations, editable slides, and infographics from a single sentence in agents like Claude Code. Ships design principles and style presets to avoid cookie-cutter output.

projects.name: google-labs-code/design.md
projects.summary: Google Labs 出品的 DESIGN.md 格式规范，用 YAML 设计令牌加 Markdown 说明给编码 Agent 传递持久化的品牌视觉系统理解，配套 lint 工具校验对比度等规则。
projects.summary_en: Google Labs' DESIGN.md format spec: YAML design tokens plus Markdown notes that give coding agents a persistent understanding of a brand's visual system, with a lint tool that checks rules such as contrast.

projects.name: microsoft/semantic-kernel
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的 LLM 应用集成 SDK，README 已提示项目演进为 Microsoft Agent Framework（企业级多 Agent 编排继任者），官方建议新用户迁移。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's LLM-app integration SDK. The README notes that the project is evolving into Microsoft Agent Framework (the enterprise multi-agent orchestration successor) and recommends new users migrate.

projects.name: manaflow-ai/cmux
projects.summary: 基于 Ghostty 的 macOS 终端，为 AI 编码 Agent 设计的垂直标签页和通知提醒，方便多任务并行管理多个 Agent 会话。
projects.summary_en: macOS terminal built on Ghostty with vertical tabs and notifications designed for AI coding agents, making it easy to run and manage many agent sessions in parallel.

projects.name: voideditor/void
projects.summary: 开源 VS Code 分支 AI 编辑器，对标 Cursor，项目已于近期宣布弃用停止维护，但仍开源可作为二次开发 VS Code 分支的参考。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI editor built as a VS Code fork, positioned against Cursor. The project recently announced it is deprecated and no longer maintained, but remains open source as a reference for building your own VS Code fork.

projects.name: huggingface/lerobot
projects.summary: Hugging Face 的机器人学习库，用 PyTorch 提供真实机器人可用的模型、数据集与工具，降低端到端学习的门槛。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's robot learning library, providing models, datasets, and tools in PyTorch for real-world robotics to lower the barrier to end-to-end learning.

projects.name: mlflow/mlflow
projects.summary: 面向 Agent、LLM 和机器学习模型的开源工程平台，提供追踪、评测、监控、Prompt 管理和 AI 网关。
projects.summary_en: An open-source engineering platform for agents, LLMs, and machine-learning models, with tracing, evaluation, monitoring, prompt management, and an AI gateway.

projects.name: HumanSignal/label-studio
projects.summary: 多类型数据标注工具，可标注图像、文本、音频、视频和时间序列，并能接入模型做预标注和主动学习。
projects.summary_en: A multi-type data labeling tool for images, text, audio, video, and time series, which can connect to models for pre-labeling and active learning.

projects.name: BloopAI/vibe-kanban
projects.summary: 面向编码 Agent 的看板任务管理工具，为 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等多种编码 Agent 分配独立工作区、审查 diff 并一键开 PR。
projects.summary_en: Kanban task manager for coding agents: gives multiple agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI isolated workspaces, lets you review diffs, and opens PRs in one click.

projects.name: openai/skills
projects.summary: OpenAI 官方 Codex 技能目录，收录可被 Codex 发现和调用的技能包；仓库已标注弃用，新技能/插件示例迁移至 openai/plugins。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's official catalog of Codex skills: skill packages that Codex can discover and invoke. The repo is marked deprecated; new skill and plugin examples have moved to openai/plugins.

projects.name: gastownhall/beads
projects.summary: 基于 Dolt 构建的分布式图结构 Issue 追踪器，给编码 Agent 提供持久化结构化记忆，替代容易丢上下文的 Markdown 计划文件，支持长周期任务跨机器同步。
projects.summary_en: Distributed graph-based issue tracker built on Dolt, giving coding agents persistent structured memory in place of Markdown plan files that lose context, with cross-machine sync for long-running tasks.

projects.name: deezer/spleeter
projects.summary: Deezer 的音源分离库，附预训练模型，可把歌曲拆分成人声、伴奏、鼓、贝斯等分轨，提供命令行和 Python 接口。
projects.summary_en: Deezer's source separation library with pretrained models that splits songs into stems such as vocals, accompaniment, drums, and bass, with a command-line tool and a Python API.

projects.name: Budibase/budibase
projects.summary: 开源运营平台，用 AI Agent、应用和自动化流程替代人工搭建内部工具，模型无关，员工可直接向 Agent 提请求自动处理。
projects.summary_en: Open-source operations platform that uses AI agents, apps, and automations instead of hand-building internal tools. Model-agnostic; employees can send requests straight to an agent for automatic handling.

projects.name: OtterMind/Chat2DB
projects.summary: 跨平台本地优先数据库客户端和 SQL 工作台，支持多种数据库，可接入自己的 AI 模型用自然语言生成、解释和优化 SQL。
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform, local-first database client and SQL workbench supporting multiple databases, which can connect to your own AI models to generate, explain, and optimize SQL in natural language.

projects.name: PrefectHQ/fastmcp
projects.summary: Prefect 的 Python MCP 应用框架，用普通 Python 函数声明工具，并自动生成 schema、校验逻辑和文档。
projects.summary_en: Prefect Python framework for MCP apps, declaring tools as plain Python functions and generating schemas, validation, and documentation.

review_history.reason: 仓库由 Prefect 项目团队或组织直接维护，统一官方标记与仓库归属。

review.reason: README 将其定义为第三方 MCP 应用框架，用于构建服务器、客户端和交互应用，不是协议规范或官方 SDK。

projects.name: eyaltoledano/claude-task-master
projects.summary: 面向 AI 驱动开发的任务管理系统，可接入 Cursor、Lovable、Windsurf、Roo 等任意 AI 编程工具，通过 MCP 提供任务拆解和跟踪。
projects.summary_en: Task-management system for AI-driven development that plugs into Cursor, Lovable, Windsurf, Roo, and any other AI coding tool, providing task breakdown and tracking over MCP.

projects.name: fastai/fastai
projects.summary: 基于 PyTorch 的高层深度学习库，用分层 API 让常见任务几行代码即可完成，同时保留底层可定制性，与配套课程和书紧密结合。
projects.summary_en: A high-level deep learning library on PyTorch whose layered API handles common tasks in a few lines while staying customizable, closely tied to the fast.ai course and book.

projects.name: nagadomi/waifu2x
projects.summary: 用深度卷积网络对动漫风格图像做超分辨率与降噪，同时也支持照片，提供在线演示与命令行实现。
projects.summary_en: Image super-resolution and noise reduction for anime-style art using deep convolutional networks, with photo support, an online demo, and a command-line implementation.

projects.name: hypit-ai/hypit
projects.summary: 让 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 用结构化工作流生成和改造视频的系统，把画面、字幕、B-roll 与特效锚定到文本，可从参考视频复刻流程或从零描述生成。
projects.summary_en: Video creation system for agents such as Claude Code and Codex. Structured workflows anchor footage, captions, B-roll, and effects to text, supporting both replication of reference videos and creation from scratch.

projects.name: CamDavidsonPilon/Probabilistic-Programming-and-Bayesian-Methods-for-Hackers
projects.summary: 《黑客的贝叶斯方法》：用 Python 与 PyMC 以代码优先的方式介绍贝叶斯推断与概率编程。
projects.summary_en: Bayesian Methods for Hackers: a code-first introduction to Bayesian inference and probabilistic programming with Python and PyMC.

projects.name: svc-develop-team/so-vits-svc
projects.summary: 基于 SoftVC 与 VITS 的歌声转换项目，可把歌声换成目标音色。仓库已进入归档状态。
projects.summary_en: A singing voice conversion project based on SoftVC and VITS that converts vocals to a target voice. The repository has been archived.

projects.name: acheong08/ChatGPT
projects.summary: 逆向工程的 ChatGPT 接口库（revChatGPT），可用于搭建聊天机器人等。仓库已归档。
projects.summary_en: A reverse-engineered ChatGPT API library (revChatGPT) usable for building chatbots and similar tools. The repository is archived.

projects.name: openai/symphony
projects.summary: OpenAI 官方实验性项目，把项目工作转成隔离的自主实现任务流，团队从“监督编码 Agent”转向“管理待完成工作”，附带 Elixir 参考实现。
projects.summary_en: Experimental OpenAI project that turns project work into isolated, autonomous implementation runs, shifting teams from "supervising coding agents" to "managing work to be done". Includes an Elixir reference implementation.

projects.name: OthmanAdi/planning-with-files
projects.summary: 面向 AI 编码 Agent 的持久化文件规划技能，把任务计划写在磁盘上的 Markdown 文件，即使上下文清空/崩溃/压缩也能恢复进度，支持多种 Agent 的 Agent Skills 标准。
projects.summary_en: Persistent file-based planning skill for AI coding agents: writes the task plan to Markdown files on disk so progress survives context clears, crashes, and compaction. Supports the Agent Skills standard across multiple agents.

projects.name: Kilo-Org/kilocode
projects.summary: Kilo 平台的开源编码 Agent，提供 VS Code、JetBrains 和命令行版本，协助完成代码编写与工程任务。
projects.summary_en: An open-source coding agent from the Kilo platform for VS Code, JetBrains, and the CLI, supporting coding and engineering tasks.

projects.name: vercel/ai
projects.summary: Vercel 官方出品的 TypeScript AI 工具包（AI SDK），面向 Next.js/React/Svelte/Vue 等框架提供统一的多模型 Provider 架构，构建 AI 应用和 Agent。
projects.summary_en: Vercel's TypeScript AI toolkit (the AI SDK), with a unified multi-model provider architecture for frameworks such as Next.js, React, Svelte, and Vue, for building AI apps and agents.

projects.name: virattt/dexter
projects.summary: 自主金融深度研究 Agent，具备任务规划、自我反思和实时行情能力，定位类似“面向金融研究的 Claude Code”，仅限教育娱乐用途不构成投资建议。
projects.summary_en: Autonomous financial deep-research agent with task planning, self-reflection, and real-time market data, positioned as "Claude Code for financial research". For educational and entertainment use only, not investment advice.

projects.name: phuryn/pm-skills
projects.summary: 产品经理技能市场，技能与工作流串联发现、策略、执行、上线到增长全流程，把 Teresa Torres、Marty Cagan 等经典 PM 方法论嵌入 Claude Code 日常工作流。
projects.summary_en: Product-manager skill marketplace: skills and workflows spanning discovery, strategy, execution, launch, and growth, embedding classic PM methods by Teresa Torres, Marty Cagan, and others into everyday Claude Code work.

projects.name: QwenLM/Qwen3
projects.summary: 阿里云 Qwen 团队官方发布的 Qwen3 系列大模型，提供从快速上手、推理到 SGLang/vLLM/TGI 大规模部署、量化的完整文档。
projects.summary_en: Alibaba Cloud Qwen team's official Qwen3 model series, with complete docs from quickstart and inference to large-scale deployment with SGLang, vLLM, and TGI, and quantization.

projects.name: xai-org/grok-build
projects.summary: xAI（SpaceXAI）官方出品的终端编码 Agent Grok Build，全屏 TUI 界面，支持鼠标交互、Headless CI 场景和编辑器内嵌（ACP 协议），代码定期从内部 monorepo 同步。
projects.summary_en: Grok Build, the terminal coding agent from xAI (SpaceXAI): full-screen TUI with mouse support, headless CI use, and editor embedding (ACP protocol). Code is synced periodically from an internal monorepo.

projects.name: Fosowl/agenticSeek
projects.summary: 完全本地运行的 Manus AI 替代品，语音交互的自主 Agent，能自主浏览网页、写代码、规划任务，使用本地模型，无需远程模型 API。
projects.summary_en: Fully local alternative to Manus AI: a voice-driven autonomous agent that browses the web, writes code, and plans tasks on its own, using local models without a remote model API.

projects.name: resemble-ai/chatterbox
projects.summary: Resemble AI 的开源文字转语音模型系列，支持多语种合成与零样本声音克隆。
projects.summary_en: Resemble AI's family of open-source text-to-speech models, supporting multilingual synthesis and zero-shot voice cloning.

projects.name: Hannibal046/Awesome-LLM
projects.summary: 大语言模型精选资源合集，收录里程碑论文、训练框架、推理工具、课程教程和公开可用的模型/API，持续更新热门趋势项目。
projects.summary_en: Curated LLM resource collection covering landmark papers, training frameworks, inference tools, courses, tutorials, and publicly available models and APIs, continuously updated with trending projects.

projects.name: yikart/AiToEarn
projects.summary: 面向“一人公司”的 AI 内容营销 Agent 平台，用自动化 Agent 帮创作者在抖音、小红书、YouTube 等十余个主流平台构建、分发并变现内容。
projects.summary_en: AI content-marketing agent platform for "one-person companies": automated agents help creators build, distribute, and monetize content across a dozen-plus major platforms such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube.

projects.name: JimLiu/baoyu-skills
projects.summary: 宝玉分享的日常效率技能合集，提供公众号封面图生成、文章配图、Markdown 转微信推文等技能，可按需单独安装。
projects.summary_en: Baoyu's collection of everyday productivity skills, including WeChat article cover images, article illustrations, and Markdown-to-WeChat conversion, skills that can be installed individually.

projects.name: Stability-AI/generative-models
projects.summary: Stability AI 的生成模型仓库，包含 SDXL、Stable Video Diffusion 及 SV4D 等图像、视频与 4D 生成模型的官方代码。
projects.summary_en: Stability AI's generative models repository with official code for image, video, and 4D generation models including SDXL, Stable Video Diffusion, and SV4D.

projects.name: onlook-dev/onlook
projects.summary: 面向设计师的 AI 优先设计工具，直接在代码库之上可视化设计和编辑前端界面。
projects.summary_en: An AI-first design tool for designers that lets you visually design and edit front-end interfaces directly on top of your codebase.

projects.name: OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V
projects.summary: 面向手机等端侧设备的高效多模态大模型系列 MiniCPM-V/MiniCPM-o，支持图像视频理解及流式音视频实时交互，OpenBMB 开源社区出品。
projects.summary_en: Family of efficient multimodal models for phones and other edge devices (MiniCPM-V and MiniCPM-o), supporting image and video understanding and streaming real-time audio/video interaction. From the OpenBMB open-source community.

projects.name: humanlayer/12-factor-agents
projects.summary: 仿照 12-Factor App 理念总结的 12 条构建可靠 LLM 应用原则，作者结合大量生产级 Agent 实践经验写成，被广泛引用的方法论文档。
projects.summary_en: Twelve principles for building reliable LLM applications, modeled on the 12-Factor App idea and written from extensive production agent experience. A widely cited methodology document.

projects.name: agentskills/agentskills
projects.summary: Agent Skills 开放标准的规范与文档仓库，定义了 SKILL.md 格式和技能的渐进式加载（发现→激活）机制，是 agentskills.io 标准的官方源。
projects.summary_en: Specification and documentation repo for the Agent Skills open standard. Defines the SKILL.md format and progressive loading of skills (discovery, then activation); the official source of the agentskills.io standard.

projects.name: Anjok07/ultimatevocalremovergui
projects.summary: 基于深度神经网络的人声分离桌面工具，用训练好的音源分离模型去除音频里的人声或伴奏。
projects.summary_en: A desktop tool that uses deep neural network source-separation models to remove vocals or accompaniment from audio.

projects.name: AgriciDaniel/claude-seo
projects.summary: Claude Code 的 SEO 技能插件，可审计网站爬取与索引、页面性能、内容质量、结构化数据及 AI 搜索可见度，并输出按优先级排序的改进方案。
projects.summary_en: An SEO skill plugin for Claude Code that audits crawlability, indexing, page performance, content quality, structured data, and AI search visibility, then produces a prioritized action plan.

review.reason: 核心交付物是 Claude Code 的 SEO 技能，符合行业技能范围。

projects.name: deepset-ai/haystack
projects.summary: 开源 AI 编排框架，用模块化管道构建具备检索、路由、记忆和生成能力的 Agent 工作流，面向可扩展的生产级 RAG 和对话系统。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI orchestration framework that builds agent workflows with retrieval, routing, memory, and generation from modular pipelines, aimed at scalable production RAG and conversational systems.

projects.name: promptfoo/promptfoo
projects.summary: LLM 评测与红队测试 CLI/库，比较 GPT/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek 等模型表现，支持声明式配置和 CI/CD 集成，README 提到项目已加入 OpenAI 但保持开源 MIT 协议独立运营。
projects.summary_en: LLM evaluation and red-teaming CLI/library that compares GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and other models, with declarative config and CI/CD integration. The README says the project has joined OpenAI but remains open source under MIT and independently operated.

projects.name: mozilla/DeepSpeech
projects.summary: Mozilla 基于百度 Deep Speech 论文的端侧离线语音转文字引擎。项目已停止维护。
projects.summary_en: Mozilla's embedded, offline speech-to-text engine based on the Deep Speech paper. The project has been discontinued.

projects.name: mozilla-ai/llamafile
projects.summary: Mozilla 官方项目，把 llama.cpp 和 Cosmopolitan Libc 结合成单文件可执行程序，跨平台免安装本地运行开源 LLM，配套 whisperfile 语音转文字工具。
projects.summary_en: Mozilla project that combines llama.cpp and Cosmopolitan Libc into a single-file executable, running open-source LLMs locally across platforms with no install. Comes with whisperfile for speech-to-text.

projects.name: zai-org/Open-AutoGLM
projects.summary: 智谱 AI 官方开源的手机端智能助理框架 AutoGLM，用多模态视觉语言模型理解屏幕内容、规划并执行 ADB 自动化操作完成用户自然语言指定的任务。
projects.summary_en: Zhipu AI's open-source phone-assistant framework AutoGLM: uses a multimodal vision-language model to understand the screen, plan, and execute ADB automation to carry out tasks the user gives in natural language.

projects.name: SYSTRAN/faster-whisper
projects.summary: 用 CTranslate2 重新实现的 Whisper，在相同精度下推理更快、显存更省，支持量化。
projects.summary_en: A reimplementation of Whisper on CTranslate2 that runs faster with lower memory use at the same accuracy, with quantization support.

projects.name: facebookresearch/fastText
projects.summary: Meta 的高效词向量学习与文本分类库，训练速度快，提供多语种预训练词向量。仓库已归档。
projects.summary_en: Meta's library for efficient word representation learning and text classification, fast to train and shipped with pretrained multilingual word vectors. The repository is archived.

projects.name: pjreddie/darknet
projects.summary: 用 C 和 CUDA 编写的神经网络框架，是早期 YOLO 目标检测模型的原始实现所在。
projects.summary_en: A neural network framework written in C and CUDA, and the home of the original YOLO object detection implementations.

projects.name: huggingface/open-r1
projects.summary: Hugging Face 官方发起的 DeepSeek-R1 完全开放复现项目，提供 SFT/GRPO 训练脚本、模型评测和从 R1 蒸馏合成数据的完整工具链。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's fully open reproduction of DeepSeek-R1, with SFT and GRPO training scripts, model evaluation, and a full toolchain for distilling synthetic data from R1.

projects.name: guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover
projects.summary: 隐私优先应用，剥离自己拥有内容上的多厂商 AI 水印/溯源标记（含 SynthID、C2PA 等），提供 Agent 技能和独立 HTTP 服务两种形态。
projects.summary_en: Privacy-first app that strips multi-vendor AI watermarks and provenance markers (including SynthID and C2PA) from content you own. Available as an agent skill and as a standalone HTTP service.

projects.name: WZMIAOMIAO/deep-learning-for-image-processing
projects.summary: 面向图像处理的深度学习教程，讲解分类与目标检测等网络的结构与创新点，并分别给出 PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 的搭建与训练代码，配套视频。
projects.summary_en: A deep learning tutorial for image processing that explains classification and detection network designs and provides PyTorch and TensorFlow implementations, with companion videos.

projects.name: a2aproject/A2A

projects.summary_en: The Agent2Agent (A2A) open protocol, hosted by the Linux Foundation, that lets opaque agent applications from different vendors communicate and collaborate with each other.

projects.name: titanwings/distilly
projects.summary: 把一个人的经验、判断力、表达风格蒸馏成可复用“人物画像”供 Agent/Bot 调用的技能（原名 Colleague Skill），面向同事、家人、公众人物等多种“人”的建模。
projects.summary_en: Skill (formerly Colleague Skill) that distills a person's experience, judgment, and expression style into a reusable "persona" agents and bots can call, for modeling colleagues, family, public figures, and other people.

projects.name: datasciencemasters/go
projects.summary: 开源的数据科学硕士课程，汇总了数据科学各方向的免费课程与阅读材料。
projects.summary_en: The Open Source Data Science Masters: a curriculum of free courses and readings across data science topics.

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents
projects.summary: Claude Code 专用子 Agent 合集，覆盖 各类开发任务，明确不接受纯广告推广类 PR，保持供应商中立。
projects.summary_en: Collection of Claude Code sub-agents covering a range of development tasks. Explicitly rejects purely promotional PRs to stay vendor-neutral.

projects.name: facebookresearch/Detectron
projects.summary: Meta AI 早期的目标检测研究平台，实现了 Mask R-CNN 等算法，已被 PyTorch 版 Detectron2 取代并弃用。
projects.summary_en: Meta AI's early object detection research platform implementing algorithms such as Mask R-CNN; it is deprecated and replaced by the PyTorch-based Detectron2.

projects.name: karpathy/llm-council
projects.summary: Karpathy 周末 vibe coding 出的小工具，把提问同时发给多个 LLM（GPT/Gemini/Claude/Grok），让它们互相匿名评审打分，再由“主席模型”汇总成最终答案。
projects.summary_en: A small weekend "vibe coding" tool by Karpathy: send a question to several LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok) at once, have them anonymously review and score each other, then let a "chairman model" merge everything into the final answer.

review.reason: README 将其定义为本地聊天 Web 应用，多模型互评后汇总答案，不模拟社会或群体行为。

projects.name: terryum/awesome-deep-learning-papers
projects.summary: 被引用最多的深度学习论文清单，作者已因论文数量激增而停止维护。
projects.summary_en: A list of the most cited deep learning papers, no longer maintained because of the volume of new papers.

projects.name: datawhalechina/pumpkin-book
projects.summary: 南瓜书：对周志华《机器学习》（西瓜书）中较难公式的解析与推导补充。
projects.summary_en: Pumpkin Book: explanations and added derivations for the harder formulas in Zhou Zhihua's Machine Learning textbook (the Watermelon Book).

projects.name: black-forest-labs/flux
projects.summary: Black Forest Labs 的 FLUX.1 官方推理仓库，提供开放权重的图像生成与编辑模型的最小推理代码。
projects.summary_en: Black Forest Labs' official inference repository for FLUX.1, with minimal inference code for its open-weight image generation and editing models.

projects.name: browserbase/stagehand
projects.summary: 浏览器 Agent SDK，像人类一样使用浏览器提取数据并与网站交互，登录状态可持久化保存，观测操作返回真实选择器避免凭据泄露给模型。
projects.summary_en: Browser agent SDK that extracts data and interacts with sites like a human. Login state persists across runs, and observed actions return real selectors so credentials are never leaked to the model.

projects.name: EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin
projects.summary: 官方“复合工程”插件，技能围绕“头脑风暴→计划→构建→评审→沉淀经验”循环组织，支持多种 Agent 宿主。
projects.summary_en: Official "compound engineering" plugin: skills organized around a brainstorm, plan, build, review, and capture-learnings loop, supporting multiple agent hosts.

review.reason: 仓库由 Every 项目团队或组织直接维护，统一官方标记与仓库归属。

projects.name: Cinnamon/kotaemon
projects.summary: 开源 RAG 文档问答工具，面向终端用户和开发者双重需求设计，提供干净可定制的聊天界面和可扩展的 RAG 管道。
projects.summary_en: Open-source RAG document Q&A tool designed for both end users and developers, with a clean customizable chat UI and an extensible RAG pipeline.

projects.name: shap/shap
projects.summary: 基于博弈论 Shapley 值的模型可解释性方法，可对任意机器学习模型的输出给出各特征的贡献。
projects.summary_en: A game-theoretic model explanation method based on Shapley values that attributes any machine learning model's output to its input features.

projects.name: earthtojake/text-to-cad
projects.summary: 给编码 Agent 增加本地 CAD 建模能力的插件，可生成 STEP、GLB、STL、3MF 文件和工程图，执行可制造性检查，并连接 3D 打印、钣金与 CNC 制造服务。
projects.summary_en: Plugin that gives coding agents local CAD workflows for generating STEP, GLB, STL, and 3MF models and engineering drawings, checking manufacturability, and connecting to 3D printing, sheet-metal, and CNC services.

projects.name: toon-format/toon
projects.summary: 面向 LLM Prompt 的紧凑序列化格式 TOON（Token-Oriented Object Notation），结合 YAML 缩进结构和 CSV 表格式，比 JSON 更省 token 且保持结构清晰，提供 TS SDK 和 CLI。
projects.summary_en: TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation), a compact serialization format for LLM prompts that combines YAML-style indentation with CSV-style tables, saving more tokens than JSON while keeping structure clear. Offers a TypeScript SDK and a CLI.

projects.name: ageron/handson-ml
projects.summary: 《Hands-On Machine Learning》第一版的配套 Notebook。第三版已发布，本仓库已弃用。
projects.summary_en: Notebooks for the first edition of Hands-On Machine Learning. The third edition is out and this repository is deprecated.

projects.name: microsoft/OmniParser
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的纯视觉 GUI Agent 屏幕解析工具，把界面截图解析成结构化元素，显著提升 GPT-4V 等模型定位和操作界面的准确率，配套 OmniTool 可控制 Windows 11 虚拟机。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's vision-only GUI-agent screen parser: turns UI screenshots into structured elements, markedly improving how accurately models like GPT-4V locate and operate interfaces. The companion OmniTool can control a Windows 11 virtual machine.

projects.name: matterport/Mask_RCNN
projects.summary: 基于 Keras 与 TensorFlow 的 Mask R-CNN 实现，可对图像中的每个实例输出边界框与分割掩码。
projects.summary_en: A Keras and TensorFlow implementation of Mask R-CNN that outputs a bounding box and segmentation mask for every object instance in an image.

projects.name: microsoft/JARVIS
projects.summary: Microsoft 早期研究项目 JARVIS/HuggingGPT，探索用 LLM 连接和调度 HuggingFace 模型社区完成复杂任务，附带 TaskBench、EasyTool 等后续研究成果。
projects.summary_en: Early Microsoft research project JARVIS/HuggingGPT, exploring using an LLM to connect and schedule models from the HuggingFace community to complete complex tasks, with follow-up work such as TaskBench and EasyTool.

projects.name: Vision-CAIR/MiniGPT-4
projects.summary: MiniGPT-4 与 MiniGPT-v2 的开源代码，把视觉编码器接到大语言模型上，实现图文对话和多种视觉语言任务。
projects.summary_en: Open-source code for MiniGPT-4 and MiniGPT-v2, which connect a vision encoder to a large language model for image-grounded chat and various vision-language tasks.

projects.name: lucidrains/vit-pytorch
projects.summary: Vision Transformer 及其大量变体（Simple ViT、NaViT、DeepViT、CaiT 等）的简洁 PyTorch 实现。
projects.summary_en: Concise PyTorch implementations of the Vision Transformer and many variants, including Simple ViT, NaViT, DeepViT, and CaiT.

projects.name: deepseek-ai/DeepInfer
projects.summary: DeepSeek 官方开源的大规模生产推理框架，面向 DeepSeek 模型提供优化内核、多种并行策略、异步调度、确定性采样、结构化输出和推测解码加速。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek's official open-source framework for large-scale production inference, providing optimized kernels, multiple parallelism strategies, asynchronous scheduling, deterministic sampling, structured outputs, and speculative-decoding acceleration for DeepSeek models.

projects.name: fastai/fastbook
projects.summary: fast.ai 的书籍，以 Jupyter Notebook 形式发布，介绍深度学习、fastai 与 PyTorch，有多种语言翻译。
projects.summary_en: The fast.ai book published as Jupyter notebooks, introducing deep learning, fastai, and PyTorch, with translations into many languages.

projects.name: activepieces/activepieces
projects.summary: 开源 Zapier 替代品，AI Agent、MCP 服务器和工作流自动化的一体化平台，贡献的 Pieces 自动成为可在 Claude Desktop/Cursor 使用的 MCP 工具。
projects.summary_en: Open-source Zapier alternative combining AI agents, MCP servers, and workflow automation. Community-contributed Pieces automatically become MCP tools usable in Claude Desktop and Cursor.

projects.name: wheresryan22/anatomy
projects.summary: 面向 Claude Code 等 Agent 的可视化技能，把技术概念转化为精细、可交互的等距视角机械图解，输出 SVG、WebGL 或 3D 图形。
projects.summary_en: A visualization skill for Claude Code and other agents that turns technical concepts into detailed, interactive isometric mechanical illustrations in SVG, WebGL, or 3D.

review.reason: 核心交付物是 Agent 可调用的图解生成技能，符合设计技能范围。

projects.name: letta-ai/letta
projects.summary: 有状态 Agent 平台（原 MemGPT），提供能持续学习和自我改进的高级记忆能力，agent harness 和交互终端已迁移至 letta-ai/letta-code 子项目。
projects.summary_en: Stateful agent platform (formerly MemGPT) with advanced memory that lets agents keep learning and improving. The agent harness and interactive terminal have moved to the letta-ai/letta-code sub-project.

projects.name: danielgatis/rembg
projects.summary: 去除图像背景的工具，可作为命令行、Python 库、HTTP 服务或 Docker 容器使用。
projects.summary_en: A tool for removing image backgrounds, usable as a command-line tool, Python library, HTTP server, or Docker container.

projects.name: agentsmd/agents.md
projects.summary: AGENTS.md 开放格式规范，相当于“写给 Agent 看的 README”，用统一位置给编码 Agent 提供项目上下文和操作指令的行业约定标准。
projects.summary_en: The AGENTS.md open format: essentially a "README for agents", a standard convention for giving coding agents project context and operating instructions in one predictable place.

projects.name: karpathy/nn-zero-to-hero

projects.summary_en: Karpathy's classic neural-network tutorial series, from hand-written backpropagation (micrograd) to language models (makemore), with companion YouTube videos and Jupyter notebooks.

projects.name: junyanz/pytorch-CycleGAN-and-pix2pix
projects.summary: CycleGAN 与 pix2pix 的 PyTorch 官方实现，用于成对与非成对的图像到图像转换。
projects.summary_en: The official PyTorch implementation of CycleGAN and pix2pix for paired and unpaired image-to-image translation.

review.reason: README 明确提供成对与非成对的 image-to-image translation 实现。

projects.name: liguodongiot/llm-action

projects.summary_en: Project sharing LLM theory and hands-on experience, systematically covering LLM training, inference, compression, evaluation, prompt engineering, and LLMOps end to end, with tutorials.

projects.name: Dao-AILab/flash-attention

projects.summary_en: Widely adopted efficient, exact attention implementation (FlashAttention, FlashAttention-2/3), the low-level acceleration library that almost every modern LLM training and inference framework depends on.

projects.name: google-ai-edge/gallery

projects.name: haotian-liu/LLaVA

projects.name: datawhalechina/llm-cookbook

projects.summary_en: Datawhale's beginner LLM tutorial for developers, translating and reproducing the LLM course series by Andrew Ng and OpenAI, covering prompt engineering, LangChain app development, and generative AI evaluation.

projects.name: NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents

projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's security scanner for agent skills, checking Claude Code, Codex, MCP, and other skills for vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks before installation.

projects.summary_en: Baidu's PaddlePaddle, China's first independently developed deep learning platform, with dynamic and static graphs, distributed training, and a deployment toolchain.

projects.name: pyg-team/pytorch_geometric

projects.name: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR

projects.summary_en: DeepSeek's open-source OCR model recognizes text and layouts in images and PDFs and converts documents to Markdown, while exploring visual encoders for text compression.

projects.name: pytorch/examples
projects.summary: PyTorch 项目的示例集合，涵盖视觉、文本和强化学习等任务，示例短小且依赖较少。
projects.summary_en: A collection of compact PyTorch examples for vision, text, reinforcement learning, and other tasks, with few dependencies.

projects.name: Tencent/ncnn

projects.summary_en: Tencent's high-performance neural network inference framework for mobile, embedded, and desktop, with no third-party runtime dependencies and CPU and Vulkan GPU backends.

projects.name: PicoTrex/Awesome-Nano-Banana-images
projects.summary: Nano Banana 系列图像模型的案例与提示词合集，展示在多种任务场景下的生成与编辑效果。
projects.summary_en: A collection of examples and prompts for the Nano Banana image models, showing generation and editing results across many task scenarios.

projects.name: sinaptik-ai/pandas-ai

projects.summary_en: Python library for analyzing data through natural-language conversation, letting non-technical users query SQL, CSV, and data lakes in plain language, powered by LLMs and RAG.

projects.name: SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework

projects.summary_en: Configuration framework that turns Claude Code into a structured development platform: slash commands, specialist agent roles, behavior modes, and MCP integrations. The same family also includes SuperGemini and SuperQwen.

projects.name: lukasmasuch/best-of-ml-python
projects.summary: 按排名整理的优秀 Python 机器学习库清单，每周自动更新。
projects.summary_en: A ranked list of awesome machine learning Python libraries, updated weekly.

projects.name: coleam00/Archon

projects.summary_en: Workflow engine for AI coding: define the development process (plan, implement, validate, review, open PR) as YAML workflows and run them repeatably and reliably. Think "GitHub Actions for AI coding".

projects.name: facebookresearch/audiocraft

projects.summary_en: Meta's deep learning library for audio generation, with inference and training code for models such as MusicGen and AudioGen for music and sound-effect generation.

projects.name: vanna-ai/vanna
projects.summary: Text-to-SQL 对话式数据库问答工具，支持用户权限控制、流式响应，并提供可嵌入网页的组件。
projects.summary_en: A conversational Text-to-SQL tool for database Q&A with user access controls, streaming responses, and an embeddable web component.

projects.name: serengil/deepface

projects.summary_en: A lightweight Python face recognition and facial attribute analysis framework that wraps several state-of-the-art face models and analyzes attributes such as age, gender, and emotion.

projects.name: jbhuang0604/awesome-computer-vision
projects.summary: 计算机视觉资源的精选清单，含课程、图书、数据集、软件与论文。
projects.summary_en: A curated list of computer vision resources, including courses, books, datasets, software, and papers.

projects.name: pgvector/pgvector

projects.summary_en: Open-source extension that adds vector similarity search to Postgres, one of the most widely used "database-native vector search" solutions.

projects.name: jundot/omlx

projects.summary_en: LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, with continuous batching and SSD-tiered KV cache, managed from the macOS menu bar, making local model serving practical for coding and other production use.

projects.name: walkinglabs/learn-harness-engineering

projects.summary_en: A project-based introductory course on agent harness engineering, covering instructions, tools, environment, state management, and verification feedback for reliable AI coding agents, available in multiple languages.

review.reason: 围绕 AI 编码 Agent Harness 的项目式课程，符合 Agent 开发教程范围。

projects.name: firecrawl/anydoc

projects.summary_en: Firecrawl's Rust document-conversion library that turns Word, PPT, Excel, PDF, and more into clean Markdown in seconds. Has Node.js, Python, and WASM bindings and is the engine behind the Firecrawl Parse service.

projects.name: Skyvern-AI/skyvern

projects.name: mlc-ai/mlc-llm

projects.name: getpaseo/paseo

projects.name: spmallick/learnopencv

projects.name: comet-ml/opik

projects.name: sebastianruder/NLP-progress

projects.name: amusi/CVPR2026-Papers-with-Code

projects.summary_en: A collection of CVPR 2026 papers and their open-source code.

projects.name: lexmount/moli

projects.summary_en: A lightweight Rust headless browser built for AI agents to fetch and extract pages, search the web, and automate browser tasks, accessible through its CLI, CDP, WebDriver Classic, and BiDi on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

taxonomy.label: 全栈框架与应用骨架
taxonomy.def: 一个项目里同时覆盖客户端与服务端的框架、站点生成器、脚手架、现成的应用底座，以及可自行部署的大型开源全栈应用
taxonomy.def_en: Frameworks, site generators, scaffolds, and application foundations that cover both client and server, plus large self-deployable open-source full-stack applications

subs.label: 全栈与元框架
subs.def: 自带路由、渲染、数据加载与服务端能力的全栈框架（Next.js、Nuxt、Remix、Rails、Laravel、Django、Phoenix 一类）
subs.def_en: Frameworks with built-in routing, rendering, data loading, and server capabilities (Next.js, Nuxt, Remix, Rails, Laravel, Django, Phoenix)

subs.label: 静态站点与文档发布
subs.def: 以内容发布为核心的静态站点与文档站框架、运行时渲染器及主题（Hugo、Jekyll、Docusaurus、docsify、MkDocs Material 一类）；通用交互式应用框架归「全栈与元框架」
subs.def_en: Content-focused static-site and documentation frameworks, runtime renderers, and themes such as Hugo, Jekyll, Docusaurus, docsify, and MkDocs Material; general interactive application frameworks belong in Full-stack & Meta-frameworks

subs.label: 脚手架与项目模板
subs.def: SaaS 模板、全栈起步项目、示例应用和最佳实践参考实现，以及 .gitignore 等项目配置模板
subs.def_en: SaaS templates, full-stack starter projects, sample apps, and reference implementations, plus project configuration templates such as .gitignore files

subs.label: 管理后台与低代码
subs.def: 后台管理模板、内部工具、低代码 / 无代码应用构建平台与工作流搭建工具
subs.def_en: Admin templates, internal tools, and low-code / no-code app and workflow builders

subs.label: CMS 与电商平台
subs.def: 无头 CMS、博客 / 建站系统与无头电商平台（Strapi、Ghost、Payload、Directus、Medusa、Saleor 一类）
subs.def_en: Headless CMS, blogging and site-building systems, and headless commerce platforms (Strapi, Ghost, Payload, Directus, Medusa, Saleor)

subs.label: 协作、沟通与社区应用
subs.def: 可自行部署的团队协作、笔记与知识库、项目管理、即时通讯、视频会议、录屏分享、协同设计和社区应用；个人云、文件同步和设备服务归「个人云与自托管服务」
subs.def_en: Self-hostable collaboration, notes and knowledge bases, project management, messaging, video meetings, screen sharing, collaborative design, and community apps; personal cloud, file sync, and device services belong in Personal Cloud & Self-hosted Services

subs.label: 业务系统与个人效率应用
subs.def: 可自行部署的 CRM、ERP、支付、日程、邮件营销、链接管理与个人财务、简历等业务和效率类应用（Odoo、ERPNext、Twenty、Cal.com、Firefly III 一类）
subs.def_en: Self-deployable CRM, ERP, payments, scheduling, email marketing, link management, personal finance, and resume apps (Odoo, ERPNext, Twenty, Cal.com, Firefly III)

subs.label: 个人云与自托管服务
subs.def: 可自行部署的个人云、文件 / 照片 / 媒体管理、DNS 过滤、文件同步、远程桌面、搜索、仪表盘、智能家居与物联网服务；以团队沟通与共创为核心的应用归「协作、沟通与社区应用」
subs.def_en: Self-hostable personal cloud, file/photo/media management, DNS filtering, file sync, remote desktop, search, dashboards, smart-home, and IoT services; team communication and co-creation apps belong in Collaboration & Community Apps

taxonomy.label: 客户端与应用框架
taxonomy.def: 用户直接接触的一层：网页、移动端、桌面端与小程序的应用框架
taxonomy.def_en: The layer users touch directly: application frameworks for web, mobile, desktop, and mini-programs

subs.label: 前端视图框架
subs.def: React、Vue、Angular、Svelte、Solid 等视图框架，以及 jQuery、htmx、Alpine 一类的轻量方案
subs.def_en: View frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and Solid, plus lightweight options like jQuery, htmx, and Alpine

subs.label: 状态、路由与数据请求
subs.def: 状态管理、路由、数据请求与缓存、表单和 Hooks 工具库（Redux、Zustand、React Router、TanStack Query、Axios 一类）
subs.def_en: State management, routing, data fetching and caching, forms, and hook utility libraries (Redux, Zustand, React Router, TanStack Query, Axios)

subs.label: 移动与跨端应用框架
subs.def: Android / iOS 开发框架、Flutter、React Native、Expo、Ionic 与小程序跨端框架
subs.def_en: Android and iOS development frameworks, Flutter, React Native, Expo, Ionic, and mini-program cross-platform frameworks

subs.label: 桌面应用框架
subs.def: Electron、Tauri、Wails 一类的桌面应用框架，以及 Rust / Go / C# 的原生 GUI 工具包
subs.def_en: Desktop frameworks such as Electron, Tauri, and Wails, and native GUI toolkits for Rust, Go, and C#

taxonomy.label: 界面组件与视觉
taxonomy.def: 搭建界面用的现成组件与图形库：组件库、动效、图表与图形、编辑器、交互小组件和媒体组件
taxonomy.def_en: Ready-made components and graphics libraries for building interfaces: component kits, motion, charts and graphics, editors, interactive widgets, and media components

subs.label: 组件库与 CSS 框架
subs.def: 组件库、设计系统和 CSS / 样式框架（shadcn/ui、Ant Design、Bootstrap、Tailwind 一类）
subs.def_en: Component libraries, design systems, and CSS and styling frameworks (shadcn/ui, Ant Design, Bootstrap, Tailwind)

subs.label: 图标、字体与主题
subs.def: 图标集与图标字体（Font Awesome、Lucide 一类）、编程字体（Fira Code、Nerd Fonts、Iosevka 一类），以及 Dracula 这类跨应用的配色主题
subs.def_en: Icon sets and icon fonts (Font Awesome, Lucide), programming fonts (Fira Code, Nerd Fonts, Iosevka), and cross-application color themes such as Dracula

subs.label: 交互小组件
subs.def: 轮播、拖拽、上传、表格、虚拟列表、引导提示、弹层与下拉等单点交互组件
subs.def_en: Single-purpose interactive widgets: carousels, drag and drop, uploads, tables, virtual lists, tours, popovers, and dropdowns

subs.label: 动画与动效
subs.def: CSS / JS 动画库、滚动动效、Lottie 一类的矢量动画渲染
subs.def_en: CSS and JS animation libraries, scroll effects, and vector animation rendering such as Lottie

subs.label: 编辑器与富文本
subs.def: 嵌入网页 / 应用的代码编辑器组件、富文本编辑框架和语法高亮（独立的编辑器与 IDE 归「编程语言与开发环境」）
subs.def_en: Code-editor components, rich-text editing frameworks, and syntax highlighting for embedding in web pages and apps (standalone editors and IDEs belong under Languages & Dev Environment)

subs.label: 图表与地图
subs.def: 图表、地图和数据可视化库（D3、ECharts、Chart.js、Leaflet、Matplotlib、Dash 一类）
subs.def_en: Chart, map, and data-visualization libraries (D3, ECharts, Chart.js, Leaflet, Matplotlib, Dash)

subs.label: 图形、游戏引擎与白板
subs.def: 2D / 3D 渲染与游戏引擎、Canvas 库、程序化图形生成、图像 / CAD 编辑、白板、图表及协同设计工具；音视频工具归「媒体、文档与演示」
subs.def_en: 2D/3D rendering and game engines, Canvas libraries, procedural graphics, image and CAD editors, whiteboards, diagrams, and collaborative design tools; audio/video tools belong in Media, Documents & Presentations

subs.label: 媒体、文档与演示
subs.def: 音视频采集、播放、录制、剪辑、转码与流媒体服务，图像压缩、文档排版、数学动画、PDF 渲染和幻灯片演示的工具与框架
subs.def_en: Tools and frameworks for audio/video capture, playback, recording, editing, transcoding, and streaming; image compression, document typesetting, mathematical animation, PDF rendering, and slides

taxonomy.label: 工程化工具链
taxonomy.def: 项目层面的构建、检查、测试与依赖管理工具
taxonomy.def_en: Project-level tools for building, checking, testing, and managing dependencies

subs.label: 构建、打包与编译
subs.def: 打包器、转译器、编译器与构建工具（Vite、webpack、Babel、esbuild、SWC、Rollup 一类）
subs.def_en: Bundlers, transpilers, compilers, and build tools (Vite, webpack, Babel, esbuild, SWC, Rollup)

subs.label: 代码规范与格式化
subs.def: Lint、格式化工具与 JavaScript / Python 的代码风格规范（ESLint、Prettier、Ruff、Black、Biome 一类）
subs.def_en: Linters, formatters, and JavaScript / Python code-style standards (ESLint, Prettier, Ruff, Black, Biome)

subs.label: 测试与性能
subs.def: 单元 / 端到端测试、浏览器自动化、压测、网页性能审计、应用安全漏洞扫描，以及网站配置与攻击面诊断；以利用漏洞或入侵为主要用途的工具不属于此类
subs.def_en: Unit and end-to-end tests, browser automation, load tests, web performance audits, application vulnerability scanning, and website-configuration or attack-surface diagnostics; tools primarily for exploitation or intrusion are out of scope

subs.label: 包管理与版本管理
subs.def: 跨语言和特定语言的包管理器、开发工具版本管理器与依赖管理，包括 Homebrew、Nix、vcpkg 等系统或 C/C++ 包管理器
subs.def_en: Cross-language and language-specific package managers, developer-tool version managers, and dependency managers, including system and C/C++ tools such as Homebrew, Nix, and vcpkg

subs.label: 开发辅助、调试与逆向
subs.def: 开发者门户、Monorepo 与组件开发环境、Git 钩子、热重载、调试器、逆向工程和开发者在线工具箱；通用 CLI 归「命令行工具」
subs.def_en: Developer portals, monorepo and component development environments, Git hooks, hot reload, debuggers, reverse-engineering tools, and online developer toolboxes; general CLI tools belong in Command-line Tools

taxonomy.label: 编程语言与开发环境
taxonomy.def: 开发者每天直接使用的东西：编程语言与编译器基础设施、代码编辑器、命令行与终端，以及构建命令行应用的框架
taxonomy.def_en: What developers use directly every day: programming languages and compiler infrastructure, code editors, the command line and terminal, and frameworks for building command-line apps

subs.label: 编程语言、运行时与编译器
subs.def: 通用与领域专用编程语言、解释器、运行时和编译器，包括数值计算领域的并行语言与 JIT 编译器
subs.def_en: General-purpose and domain-specific programming languages, interpreters, runtimes, and compilers, including parallel languages and JIT compilers for numerical computing

subs.label: 代码编辑器与 IDE
subs.def: 开发者日常使用的独立代码编辑器、IDE 和远程开发环境（VS Code、Vim / Neovim、Zed、Helix 一类），以及 Vim / Neovim / Emacs 的发行版、配置与插件管理；嵌入网页的编辑器组件归「编辑器与富文本」
subs.def_en: Standalone code editors, IDEs, and remote development environments developers use daily (VS Code, Vim / Neovim, Zed, Helix), plus Vim, Neovim, and Emacs distributions, configurations, and plugin managers; editor components embedded in web pages belong under Editors & Rich Text

subs.label: Shell 与终端
subs.def: Shell、终端模拟器与复用器、提示符、插件、补全、dotfiles 配置，以及提供 Linux 命令行环境的兼容层
subs.def_en: Shells, terminal emulators and multiplexers, prompts, plugins, completions, dotfiles, and compatibility layers providing a Linux command-line environment

subs.label: Git 与版本控制工具
subs.def: Git 本体、其他版本控制系统，以及 Git 图形与终端客户端、差异查看和分支工作流工具（Git、Jujutsu、Lazygit、Delta 一类）
subs.def_en: Git itself, other version control systems, and Git terminal clients, diff viewers, and branching-workflow tools (Git, Jujutsu, Lazygit, Delta)

subs.label: 命令行工具
subs.def: curl 等命令行基础工具，以及 fzf、ripgrep、jq、bat 一类的现代命令行工具、文件管理器、系统监控与基准测试工具
subs.def_en: Core command-line tools such as curl, plus modern CLI tools like fzf, ripgrep, jq, and bat, file managers, system monitors, and benchmarking tools

subs.label: CLI 与 TUI 框架
subs.def: 用来构建命令行与终端界面应用的框架和库：参数解析、终端样式、进度条与 TUI 组件（Cobra、Bubble Tea、Ratatui、Ink、Textual、Rich 一类）
subs.def_en: Frameworks and libraries for building command-line and terminal UI applications: argument parsing, terminal styling, progress bars, and TUI components (Cobra, Bubble Tea, Ratatui, Ink, Textual, Rich)

taxonomy.label: 后端与服务框架
taxonomy.def: 服务端框架、微服务治理、API 层、认证与后端即服务
taxonomy.def_en: Server-side frameworks, microservice governance, API layers, authentication, and back-end-as-a-service

subs.label: 后端框架
subs.def: Express、FastAPI、Spring Boot、Gin、NestJS 等服务端 Web 框架与网络应用框架
subs.def_en: Server-side web and network-application frameworks such as Express, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Gin, and NestJS

subs.label: 微服务与服务治理
subs.def: 微服务与 RPC 框架、服务发现、配置中心、熔断限流、分布式事务、任务调度与分布式服务运行时（Dubbo、Go Zero、Dapr、Nacos、Sentinel、etcd 一类）
subs.def_en: Microservice and RPC frameworks, service discovery, configuration centers, circuit breaking and rate limiting, distributed transactions, job scheduling, and distributed service runtimes (Dubbo, Go Zero, Dapr, Nacos, Sentinel, etcd)

subs.label: API 与网关
subs.def: API 设计、请求调试、文档、GraphQL / tRPC / gRPC、网关与代理框架、实时通信；开发调试用的 HTTP 拦截代理归此类，专门用于攻击的工具不收录
subs.def_en: API design, request debugging, and documentation, GraphQL / tRPC / gRPC, gateways and proxy frameworks, and real-time communication; HTTP intercepting proxies used for development belong here, while attack-focused tools are out of scope

subs.label: 认证、身份与密钥
subs.def: 登录、SSO、身份管理、权限控制、特权访问与凭据加密管理工具
subs.def_en: Login, SSO, identity management, access control, privileged access, and credential encryption or management tools

subs.label: 后端即服务
subs.def: 开箱即用的后端服务（认证、数据库、存储、实时），Supabase、Appwrite 一类
subs.def_en: Ready-made back-end services (auth, database, storage, real time) such as Supabase and Appwrite

taxonomy.label: 数据与中间件
taxonomy.def: 应用背后的数据库、ORM、缓存、搜索、消息、网页数据采集、数据处理与分析
taxonomy.def_en: Databases, ORMs, caching, search, messaging, web data collection, processing, and analytics behind applications

subs.label: 数据库引擎
subs.def: 关系型、文档型、时序、分析型（OLAP）、嵌入式与键值存储引擎
subs.def_en: Relational, document, time-series, analytical (OLAP), embedded, and key-value storage engines

subs.label: ORM 与数据库工具
subs.def: ORM / 查询构建器、数据库客户端与建模工具
subs.def_en: ORMs, query builders, database clients, and modeling tools

subs.label: 缓存、搜索与对象存储
subs.def: 缓存与内存数据库、搜索引擎和对象存储（Redis、Elasticsearch、MinIO、Meilisearch 一类）
subs.def_en: Caches and in-memory databases, search engines, and object storage (Redis, Elasticsearch, MinIO, Meilisearch)

subs.label: 消息与任务队列
subs.def: 消息队列、事件流、后台任务队列与通知基础设施（Kafka、RocketMQ、Celery 一类）
subs.def_en: Message queues, event streaming, background task queues, and notification infrastructure (Kafka, RocketMQ, Celery)

subs.label: 数据处理与工作流编排
subs.def: 流 / 批处理、ETL、数据同步、外部数据源接入（含金融数据 API）、DataFrame 引擎，以及工作流与任务编排引擎
subs.def_en: Stream/batch processing, ETL, data sync, external data-source connectors (including financial data APIs), DataFrame engines, and workflow/task orchestration

subs.label: 数据分析、BI 与产品分析
subs.def: 可自托管的 BI 与数据分析平台，以及网站与产品分析工具（Superset、Metabase、PostHog、Plausible 一类）
subs.def_en: Self-hostable BI and data-analysis platforms, and website and product analytics tools (Superset, Metabase, PostHog, Plausible)

subs.label: 网页抓取与数据采集
subs.def: 通用网页与社交平台抓取框架、可视化爬虫和代理池；以生成 LLM 可用上下文为核心的专用工具归 AI「网页抓取」
subs.def_en: General web and social scraping frameworks, visual crawlers, and proxy pools; tools centered on model-ready context belong in AI Web Crawling

taxonomy.label: 通用库与 SDK
taxonomy.def: 按语言生态归类的通用工具库和客户端库
taxonomy.def_en: General-purpose utility and client libraries grouped by language ecosystem

subs.label: JS / TS 通用库
subs.def: 日期、校验、数据处理、文档与图片处理、HTTP 与响应式等 JavaScript / TypeScript 库
subs.def_en: JavaScript / TypeScript libraries for dates, validation, data handling, document and image processing, HTTP, and reactive programming

subs.label: JVM / Android 通用库
subs.def: Java、Kotlin 与 Android 的工具库、网络库与图片加载库
subs.def_en: Utility, networking, and image-loading libraries for Java, Kotlin, and Android

subs.label: Python / Go / Swift / PHP 通用库
subs.def: 其他语言生态的 HTTP 客户端、日志、配置与校验库
subs.def_en: HTTP clients, logging, configuration, and validation libraries from other language ecosystems

subs.label: C / C++ 通用库
subs.def: C / C++ 生态的通用基础库，覆盖 JSON、格式化、日志、测试、异步 I/O、压缩与密码学；包管理器归「包管理与版本管理」
subs.def_en: General C/C++ libraries for JSON, formatting, logging, testing, asynchronous I/O, compression, and cryptography; package managers belong in Package & Version Management

taxonomy.label: 部署与运维
taxonomy.def: 把应用发布上线、跑起来并保持健康
taxonomy.def_en: Getting an application shipped, running, and healthy

subs.label: 容器与运行时
subs.def: 容器引擎、容器运行时、Compose、镜像工具与容器管理界面（Docker、Podman、Portainer 一类）
subs.def_en: Container engines and runtimes, Compose, image tooling, and container management UIs (Docker, Podman, Portainer)

subs.label: Kubernetes 与集群管理
subs.def: Kubernetes 及其发行版、本地集群、服务网格、包管理、镜像仓库与集群管理工具（Kubernetes、K3s、Istio、Helm、K9s 一类）
subs.def_en: Kubernetes and its distributions, local clusters, service meshes, package management, registries, and cluster management tools (Kubernetes, K3s, Istio, Helm, K9s)

subs.label: 基础设施即代码
subs.def: 用代码声明和管理基础设施与环境（Terraform、OpenTofu、Pulumi、Ansible、Vagrant）
subs.def_en: Declaring and managing infrastructure and environments as code (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Ansible, Vagrant)

subs.label: 部署与自托管平台
subs.def: 自托管 PaaS、部署面板、Serverless 框架、进程管理与本地云模拟
subs.def_en: Self-hosted PaaS, deployment panels, serverless frameworks, process managers, and local cloud emulation

subs.label: 反向代理、证书与隧道
subs.def: 面向应用发布和远程开发的 Web 服务器、反向代理、Web 应用防火墙、HTTPS 证书自动化及内网开发隧道；通用翻墙客户端与 VPN 不属于此类
subs.def_en: Web servers, reverse proxies, web application firewalls, HTTPS certificate automation, and development tunnels for deploying or accessing apps; general circumvention clients and VPNs are out of scope

subs.label: CI/CD 与自动化
subs.def: 持续集成 / 交付、发布自动化、依赖更新，以及带 CI 能力的自托管 Git 代码托管平台
subs.def_en: Continuous integration and delivery, release automation, dependency updates, and self-hosted Git hosting platforms with built-in CI

subs.label: 监控与可观测
subs.def: 指标、日志、链路追踪、错误追踪、应用监控与性能诊断
subs.def_en: Metrics, logs, distributed tracing, error tracking, application monitoring, and performance diagnostics

taxonomy.label: 学习与教程
taxonomy.def: 路线图、课程、语言教程与底层原理的学习资料
taxonomy.def_en: Roadmaps, courses, language tutorials, and learning material on how things work underneath

subs.label: 路线图与综合课程
subs.def: 开发者路线图、综合课程、编程书单、CS 自学路线、大学课程清单、论文阅读、项目创意与实战项目合集
subs.def_en: Developer roadmaps, comprehensive courses, programming book lists, CS self-study paths, university course lists, paper reading, project ideas, and hands-on project collections

subs.label: 前端、JavaScript 与移动教程
subs.def: JavaScript、TypeScript、React、CSS、HTML 与 Android / Flutter 的教程、速查表、练习、周刊与知识体系
subs.def_en: Tutorials, cheat sheets, exercises, weeklies, and knowledge bases for JavaScript, TypeScript, React, CSS, HTML, and Android and Flutter

subs.label: 编程语言教程
subs.def: Python、Go、Rust、C++、Java 等语言的教程、速查表、练习和「陷阱」合集，以及正则表达式等通用语言技能
subs.def_en: Tutorials, cheat sheets, exercises, and gotcha collections for languages such as Python, Go, Rust, C++, and Java, plus general skills such as regular expressions

subs.label: 命令行、Git 与运维实践
subs.def: 命令行、Git、Docker、Kubernetes、DevOps 与云服务的教程、速查表和练习
subs.def_en: Tutorials, cheat sheets, and exercises for the command line, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, DevOps, and cloud services

subs.label: 操作系统与编译原理
subs.def: 操作系统内核、从零写操作系统、编译器与小型系统实现的源码解读和教程
subs.def_en: Source-code walkthroughs and tutorials on operating-system kernels, writing an OS from scratch, compilers, and small system implementations

subs.label: 算法与数据结构
subs.def: 算法与数据结构的多语言实现、刷题题解与攻略、可视化和学习路线
subs.def_en: Multi-language algorithm and data-structure implementations, LeetCode solutions and guides, visualizers, and study paths

taxonomy.label: 面试、规范与清单
taxonomy.def: 面试与系统设计指南、编码规范与最佳实践、精选清单
taxonomy.def_en: Interview and system-design guides, coding standards and best practices, and curated lists

subs.label: 系统设计与面试
subs.def: 系统设计、分布式、编码面试和前后端岗位的面试指南（不含纯算法题库，那类归「算法与数据结构」）
subs.def_en: System design, distributed systems, coding-interview, and front-end / back-end interview guides (pure algorithm collections belong under Algorithms & Data Structures)

subs.label: 最佳实践与规范
subs.def: 编码规范、设计模式、API 指南、项目结构与工程实践清单
subs.def_en: Coding standards, design patterns, API guidelines, project structure, and engineering-practice checklists

subs.label: 前端与移动精选清单
subs.def: 围绕前端框架、组件、移动端与桌面端技术栈的 Awesome 列表和资源导航
subs.def_en: Awesome lists and resource directories around front-end frameworks, components, and mobile and desktop stacks

subs.label: 语言、后端与通用精选清单
subs.def: 围绕编程语言、后端、运维、自托管、命令行、自动化工作流模板和开源项目发现的资源清单；针对前端与移动生态的清单归「前端与移动精选清单」
subs.def_en: Resource lists for programming languages, back ends, operations, self-hosting, command lines, automation workflow templates, and open-source discovery; front-end and mobile lists belong in Front-end & Mobile Lists

projects.name: codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x
projects.summary: 通过从零重新实现常用技术来学习编程的分步教程合集，按主题收录 3D 渲染器、数据库、Docker、Git、Shell、前端框架、编程语言、操作系统、区块链等数十类「自己动手写」的指南。
projects.summary_en: A compilation of step-by-step guides for learning programming by re-creating popular technologies from scratch, organized by topic across dozens of categories such as 3D renderers, databases, Docker, Git, shells, front-end frameworks, programming languages, operating systems, and blockchains.

projects.name: sindresorhus/awesome
projects.summary: 各类主题 Awesome 清单的总目录，按平台、编程语言、前端、后端、CS、工具等分类收录数百个高质量精选列表，并给出创建与贡献 Awesome 列表的规范。
projects.summary_en: The master index of Awesome lists, grouping hundreds of curated lists by platform, programming language, front-end, back-end, computer science, and tooling, with guidelines for creating and contributing to one.

projects.name: public-apis/public-apis
projects.summary: 按类别整理的免费公共 API 清单，涵盖天气、地理、金融、开发工具等数十个领域，每条标注是否需要认证、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS。
projects.summary_en: A categorized list of free public APIs across dozens of domains such as weather, geodata, finance, and developer tools, with each entry noting authentication, HTTPS, and CORS support.

projects.name: freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp
projects.summary: 非营利组织 freeCodeCamp 的开源代码与课程体系，通过互动练习和项目认证免费教授 Web 开发、数据库、Python 与计算机科学。
projects.summary_en: The open-source codebase and curriculum of the nonprofit freeCodeCamp, teaching web development, databases, Python, and computer science for free through interactive exercises and certification projects.

projects.name: EbookFoundation/free-programming-books
projects.summary: 免费编程学习资源索引，按语言和主题收录多种语言的免费书籍、课程、交互式教程、播客与速查表，附可搜索网站。
projects.summary_en: An index of freely available programming learning resources, listing free books, courses, interactive tutorials, podcasts, and cheat sheets by language and topic in many human languages, with a searchable website.

projects.name: donnemartin/system-design-primer
projects.summary: 系统设计入门指南：讲解可扩展系统的常见模式（负载均衡、缓存、分库分表、消息队列等），附面试题、示例方案和 Anki 记忆卡片，提供多语言翻译。
projects.summary_en: A primer on designing large-scale systems, covering common scalability patterns such as load balancing, caching, sharding, and queues, with interview questions, sample solutions, and Anki flashcards in many languages.

projects.name: nilbuild/developer-roadmap
